prompt: Any amount above 40,000 rupees is prohibited, and so is any payment from a rooted or jailbroken handset.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 40000 OR device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_rooted_device"

prompt: Decline any payment made before 3pm from a device that is under a week old.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 15 AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_new_device"

prompt: Refer to manual review any payment below 50k, and any payment from a device under a week old.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 50000 OR device.age_days < 7 THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_new_device"

prompt: Travel merchant payments from devices older than 1 day must be referred to a reviewer.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND device.age_days > 1 THEN REVIEW reason="travel_merchant_high_device"

prompt: Block verified users whose account is under a month old when the device is 45 days old or more.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days < 30 AND device.age_days >= 45 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_low_account"

prompt: A device less than 2 days old that has made more than 20 payments in the last hour is blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 2 AND txn.count_1h > 20 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_high_txns"

prompt: If the device is not rooted and the user has fewer than 50 payments in the last hour, block it.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 50 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_unrooted_device"

prompt: Payments under 2,500 rupees shall be declined when the account is 3 days old or less, unless the merchant is grocery or electronics.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [GROCERY, ELECTRONICS] AND txn.amount < 2500 AND user.account_age_days <= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_low_amount"

prompt: Allow food orders where the user has 3 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours and either the device is rooted or the account is no more than 2 days old.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 3 AND (device.is_rooted OR user.account_age_days <= 2) THEN ALLOW reason="food_merchant_low_failures"

prompt: International payments of 20 lakh or more go to manual review when the user has more than 10 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 2000000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 10 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_high_failures"

prompt: Block a payment if the merchant is not travel, or the amount is 7.5 lakh or more, or the user has made more than 2 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != TRAVEL OR txn.amount >= 750000 OR txn.count_1h > 2 THEN BLOCK reason="travel_merchant_high_amount"

prompt: Accounts younger than 15 days with fewer than 8 failed attempts in 24 hours may pass.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 8 AND user.account_age_days < 15 THEN ALLOW reason="low_failures_low_account"

prompt: International payments below 20 lakh need a manual review.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 2000000 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_international"

prompt: International payments before 11pm, with fewer than 15 payments in the last hour from devices less than 120 days old, are permitted.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 23 AND txn.count_1h < 15 AND txn.is_international AND device.age_days < 120 THEN ALLOW reason="early_hours_low_txns"

prompt: Rooted devices used by KYC-verified users whose account is under a month old shall be declined.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days < 30 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_kyc_verified"

prompt: Accounts more than 90 days old that have made fewer than 2 payments in the last hour must be declined.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 90 AND txn.count_1h < 2 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_low_txns"

prompt: Users with more than 15 failed attempts in 24 hours may not make international travel payments before 6pm.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 15 AND merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.hour < 18 AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_travel_merchant"

prompt: Permit a payment where the merchant is outside utilities or the method is netbanking, provided the user has at most 3 failed attempts in 24 hours and the device is at least 180 days old.
rule: WHEN (merchant.category != UTILITIES OR txn.method == NETBANKING) AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 3 AND device.age_days >= 180 THEN ALLOW reason="utilities_merchant_netbanking_method"

prompt: Unverified accounts under a month old that pay from a device older than 14 days must be reviewed.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 14 AND user.account_age_days < 30 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_new_account"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants paid by KYC-verified users go to review if the payment is international or the user has fewer than 10 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND user.kyc_verified AND (txn.is_international OR user.failed_attempts_24h < 10) THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_kyc_verified"

prompt: Payments may pass if the user has made 20 or more payments in the last hour, or the merchant is travel, or the device is not rooted.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 20 OR merchant.category == TRAVEL OR NOT device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns_travel_merchant"

prompt: Block domestic payments from KYC-verified users with fewer than 4 failed attempts in 24 hours when more than 5 payments were made in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 4 AND user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h > 5 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_low_failures"

prompt: Rooted devices under a week old, with more than 1 failed attempt in 24 hours, paying before 11pm shall be declined.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND device.is_rooted AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 1 AND txn.hour < 23 THEN BLOCK reason="new_device_rooted_device"

prompt: UPI payments from users with no failed attempts in the last 24 hours, for domestic transfers only, go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="upi_method_no_failures"

prompt: Utility payments to merchants not on the trusted list are declined when the user has made 3 or fewer payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 3 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND merchant.category == UTILITIES THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Users with at least one failed attempt in 24 hours who pay by netbanking must be referred.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 1 AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures_netbanking_method"

prompt: Block if the payment is international, or the user has 4 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours, or the amount is 2,500 rupees or more.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international OR user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 OR txn.amount >= 2500 THEN BLOCK reason="international_low_failures"

prompt: UPI payments from devices that are not rooted are permitted.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="upi_method_unrooted_device"

prompt: Devices more than a year old are blocked when either the user has 4 or fewer payments in the last hour or the account is under a month old.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 365 AND (txn.count_1h <= 4 OR user.account_age_days < 30) THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_low_txns"

prompt: Payments from 4pm onwards are prohibited.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 16 THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours"

prompt: Domestic payments of exactly 1 rupee must be referred for review.
rule: WHEN txn.amount == 1 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="exact_amount_domestic"

prompt: Transactions by users who have made 100 or fewer payments in the last hour are declined.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 100 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns"

prompt: Verified users with fewer than 6 failed attempts in 24 hours who pay a whitelisted merchant shall be declined.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 6 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_low_failures"

prompt: Payments from devices under a week old must be referred when the user has fewer than 12 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 12 AND device.age_days < 7 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_new_device"

prompt: While the user has 30 or fewer payments in the last hour, payments to merchants off the trusted list are referred for review.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.count_1h <= 30 THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_low_txns"

prompt: Devices under 45 days old may pay merchants that are not whitelisted.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 45 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="low_device_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Refer to manual review any payment under 250 rupees from an account a year old or younger.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 365 AND txn.amount < 250 THEN REVIEW reason="low_account_low_amount"

prompt: Decline a payment when the user has fewer than 6 payments in the last hour and the payment is either made from 1pm onwards or international.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 6 AND (txn.hour >= 13 OR txn.is_international) THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_late_hours"

prompt: Verified users with 8 or fewer failed attempts in the last 24 hours are blocked.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 8 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_low_failures"

prompt: Users with at least 4 failed attempts in 24 hours and fewer than 30 payments in the last hour go to review when the device is older than 10 days or the user is KYC-verified.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 AND txn.count_1h < 30 AND (device.age_days > 10 OR user.kyc_verified) THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures_low_txns"

prompt: A payment of 5 lakh or more to a merchant not on the whitelist may pass when the user has no failed attempts in the last 24 hours.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 AND txn.amount >= 500000 THEN ALLOW reason="unlisted_merchant_no_failures"

prompt: Devices 21 days old or less that have made more than 30 payments in the last hour are blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 21 AND txn.count_1h > 30 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_high_txns"

prompt: Allow a payment if the account is more than 5 days old or the amount is under 60k.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 5 OR txn.amount < 60000 THEN ALLOW reason="high_account_low_amount"

prompt: Block any device two weeks old or more, and any rooted phone.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 14 OR device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_rooted_device"

prompt: Any domestic payment of 80k or more must be referred, and so must any payment going to a whitelisted merchant
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 80000 AND NOT txn.is_international OR merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_domestic"

prompt: Netbanking payments made when the user has more than 30 payments in the last hour must go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND txn.count_1h > 30 THEN REVIEW reason="netbanking_method_high_txns"

prompt: Grocery, utilities or gaming payments are referred when the user has made more than 12 payments in the last hour and either the payment is before 5pm or the device is under 60 days old.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GROCERY, UTILITIES, GAMING] AND txn.count_1h > 12 AND (txn.hour < 17 OR device.age_days < 60) THEN REVIEW reason="listed_merchant_high_txns"

prompt: Between 2am and 6am, decline payments from users with more than 2 failed attempts in 24 hours who have made at least 3 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 3 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 2 AND txn.hour >= 2 AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_high_failures"

prompt: Wallet or card payments from verified users, made from 10am onwards on devices older than 30 days, are prohibited.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 10 AND user.kyc_verified AND txn.method IN [WALLET, CARD] AND device.age_days > 30 THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_kyc_verified"

prompt: International payments from accounts under 21 days old must be reviewed if the user is verified or the device is more than 15 days old.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 21 AND txn.is_international AND (user.kyc_verified OR device.age_days > 15) THEN REVIEW reason="low_account_international"

prompt: Unverified users paying by anything other than card or wallet need manual review.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.method IN [CARD, WALLET] AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="listed_method_no_kyc"

prompt: Payments made before 6am are blocked when the user has 10 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 10 THEN BLOCK reason="night_low_failures"

prompt: Block payments from 10pm onwards to non-whitelisted merchants from devices that are not rooted.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 22 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: From 4pm onwards, block any user with fewer than 3 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 16 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 3 THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_low_failures"

prompt: International payments from devices 10 days old or less must be referred when the merchant is gaming or the user has made 25 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 10 AND txn.is_international AND (merchant.category == GAMING OR txn.count_1h >= 25) THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_international"

prompt: UPI payments to non-grocery merchants from accounts under a month old shall be declined.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND merchant.category != GROCERY AND user.account_age_days < 30 THEN BLOCK reason="upi_method_grocery_merchant"

prompt: Refer to review any payment where the user is unverified and the device is not rooted, and also any payment going to FOOD merchants.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT device.is_rooted OR merchant.category == FOOD THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_unrooted_device"

prompt: Unverified users paying a whitelisted, non-travel merchant from a device 90 days old or less are blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != TRAVEL AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days <= 90 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="travel_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: International payments below 1 crore are referred for review when the user has at most 2 payments in the last hour and fewer than 4 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 2 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 4 AND txn.amount < 10000000 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_low_failures"

prompt: Payments before 8pm from devices older than 21 days go to a reviewer.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 21 AND txn.hour < 20 THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_early_hours"

prompt: Non-rooted devices with 10 or more payments in the last hour may proceed.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h >= 10 THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_high_txns"

prompt: Block devices 7 days old or less, except rooted devices whose user is KYC-verified.
rule: WHEN (NOT device.is_rooted OR NOT user.kyc_verified) AND device.age_days <= 7 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_no_kyc"

prompt: A payment may pass if the user has 3 or more failed attempts in 24 hours, or the merchant is electronics, or the merchant is not whitelisted.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 OR merchant.category == ELECTRONICS OR NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_electronics_merchant"

prompt: Rooted devices paying 2,500 rupees or more, with fewer than 3 failed attempts in 24 hours, are declined.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.amount >= 2500 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 3 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_high_amount"

prompt: Grocery payments before noon may go through for users with more than 8 failed attempts in the last 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 8 AND txn.hour < 12 AND merchant.category == GROCERY THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_early_hours"

prompt: Payments of 7.5 lakh or more from non-rooted devices are blocked for users with fewer than 8 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 8 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.amount >= 750000 THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_unrooted_device"

prompt: For unverified users with at least 4 failed attempts in 24 hours, payments of 3,000 rupees or less to merchants not on the whitelist are sent for review.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 AND txn.amount <= 3000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_high_failures"

prompt: Any account older than 2 days is blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 2 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account"

prompt: Netbanking payments to whitelisted merchants from 1pm onwards are declined.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour >= 13 AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_late_hours"

prompt: Any payment under 2 lakh is blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 200000 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount"

prompt: Rooted devices that are a week old or older shall be declined.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND device.age_days >= 7 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_high_device"

prompt: Block any payment from noon onwards, and any payment of 25k or less.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 12 OR txn.amount <= 25000 THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_low_amount"

prompt: UPI payments are prohibited for users with 8 or more failed attempts in the last 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 8 THEN BLOCK reason="upi_method_high_failures"

prompt: Grocery, electronics and gaming payments shall be declined when the user has at least 2 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GROCERY, ELECTRONICS, GAMING] AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 2 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_high_failures"

prompt: Gaming, food and utilities payments from non-rooted devices, where the user has made 2 or fewer payments in the last hour, may pass.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND merchant.category IN [GAMING, FOOD, UTILITIES] AND txn.count_1h <= 2 THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_listed_merchant"

prompt: A payment of 12k or less is blocked for users with fewer than 20 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 12000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 20 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_low_failures"

prompt: Merchants off the trusted list may be paid from noon onwards.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour >= 12 THEN ALLOW reason="unlisted_merchant_late_hours"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants may take payments from users who have made 100 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 100 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Rooted devices paying before 6pm are referred to manual review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.hour < 18 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_early_hours"

prompt: International payments to non-whitelisted merchants from accounts 15 days old or more must go to review.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND user.account_age_days >= 15 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_high_account"

prompt: Accounts 15 days old or younger shall be declined.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 15 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account"

prompt: Overnight payments under 7.5 lakh to non-whitelisted merchants by unverified users are blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour < 6 AND txn.amount < 750000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_night"

prompt: Users with fewer than 20 failed attempts in 24 hours have their payments referred for review.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 20 THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures"

prompt: Unverified accounts under a month old are blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days < 30 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_low_account"

prompt: Rooted devices older than 45 days go to review when the payment is international or the user has more than 20 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN (txn.is_international OR user.failed_attempts_24h > 20) AND device.age_days > 45 AND device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="international_high_failures"

prompt: Devices under 3 days old are blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 3 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device"

prompt: UPI payments from verified users need a manual review.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.method == UPI THEN REVIEW reason="kyc_verified_upi_method"

prompt: Anything made before 1am that is not a wallet payment is blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 1 AND txn.method != WALLET THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_wallet_method"

prompt: Verified users are blocked, as is any payment from 4pm onwards.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 16 OR user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_kyc_verified"

prompt: Anything paid from a non-rooted device, or from a device 1 day old or less, is blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted OR device.age_days <= 1 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_low_device"

prompt: Unverified users paying whitelisted gaming or food merchants before 6am are blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GAMING, FOOD] AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: Non-rooted devices are blocked when the user has made 12 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h >= 12 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_txns"

prompt: Electronics payments before 6pm from accounts under a month old shall be declined.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.hour < 18 AND user.account_age_days < 30 THEN BLOCK reason="electronics_merchant_early_hours"

prompt: Accounts 5 days old or more that pay by anything other than netbanking must be referred.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 5 AND txn.method != NETBANKING THEN REVIEW reason="high_account_netbanking_method"

prompt: International utility payments before 6am are permitted where the method is neither card nor netbanking.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND txn.hour < 6 AND NOT txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING] AND txn.is_international THEN ALLOW reason="utilities_merchant_night"

prompt: Non-rooted devices may pay before 2pm when the payment is international or the merchant is grocery.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.hour < 14 AND (txn.is_international OR merchant.category == GROCERY) THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_early_hours"

prompt: Grocery, gaming or electronics payments before 6am from devices under 45 days old, to merchants not on the whitelist, go to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GROCERY, GAMING, ELECTRONICS] AND device.age_days < 45 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour < 6 THEN REVIEW reason="listed_merchant_low_device"

prompt: Devices 45 days old or less may make payments.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 45 THEN ALLOW reason="low_device"

prompt: Accounts under a month old may not pay 25k or less from a device that is not rooted.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.amount <= 25000 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_new_account"

prompt: Card or wallet payments to whitelisted merchants may proceed when the user has 4 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 AND txn.method IN [CARD, WALLET] THEN ALLOW reason="whitelisted_merchant_high_failures"

prompt: Exactly 35k payments are blocked when the user has made 10 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 10 AND txn.amount == 35000 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_exact_amount"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants may not take payments from 2pm onwards.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour >= 14 THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_late_hours"

prompt: Domestic payments of 20 lakh or more may pass.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 2000000 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN ALLOW reason="high_amount_domestic"

prompt: Payments of 7.5 lakh or more from devices under a week old must be referred to a reviewer.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 750000 AND device.age_days < 7 THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_new_device"

prompt: Once the user has made 25 or more payments in the last hour, non-grocery payments from devices under 7 days old are allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 25 AND merchant.category != GROCERY AND device.age_days < 7 THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns_grocery_merchant"

prompt: Payments of 100 rupees or less from rooted devices are referred for review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.amount <= 100 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_low_amount"

prompt: Netbanking payments under 5k to whitelisted merchants go to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount < 5000 AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_low_amount"

prompt: Review any payment from a non-rooted device, and any payment where the user has made 50 or more in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 50 OR NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_unrooted_device"

prompt: Card payments are blocked if made from 9pm onwards or from a device that is not rooted.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND (txn.hour >= 21 OR NOT device.is_rooted) THEN BLOCK reason="card_method_late_hours"

prompt: Card and UPI payments may pass where the user has made more than 30 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 30 AND txn.method IN [CARD, UPI] THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns_listed_method"

prompt: Accounts two years old or more must be referred for review.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 730 THEN REVIEW reason="high_account"

prompt: Accounts two months old or less that pay from non-rooted devices 15 days old or more are to be reviewed.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 15 AND user.account_age_days <= 60 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_low_account"

prompt: Unverified users paying by any method other than wallet go to review.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.method != WALLET THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_wallet_method"

prompt: Travel payments of 1 lakh or less made before 7am by users with more than 1 failed attempt in 24 hours are declined.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 7 AND merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.amount <= 100000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 1 THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_travel_merchant"

prompt: Anything above 7,500 rupees goes to review when the user has made 5 or more payments in the last hour and either the account is 1 day old or less or the user has more than 15 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 7500 AND txn.count_1h >= 5 AND (user.account_age_days <= 1 OR user.failed_attempts_24h > 15) THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_high_txns"

prompt: Card payments from rooted devices must be referred when the user has no failed attempts in the last 24 hours, or when they are made from 4pm onwards.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND device.is_rooted AND (user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 OR txn.hour >= 16) THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_rooted_device"

prompt: Users with 4 or fewer payments in the last hour are blocked for any payment of 12k or more.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 4 AND txn.amount >= 12000 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_high_amount"

prompt: International payments from 11pm onwards are prohibited.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.hour >= 23 THEN BLOCK reason="international_late_hours"

prompt: Payments made at 4am or later may go through.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 4 THEN ALLOW reason="late_hours"

prompt: Block any payment made before 6am, and any card or UPI payment at any hour.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 OR txn.method IN [CARD, UPI] THEN BLOCK reason="night_listed_method"

prompt: Refer for review any international payment to a merchant that is not food, and any payment made from 1am up to 5am.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != FOOD AND txn.is_international OR txn.hour >= 1 AND txn.hour < 5 THEN REVIEW reason="food_merchant_international"

prompt: A payment goes to review if the user is not KYC-verified, or the merchant is not utilities, or the amount is 250 rupees or less.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified OR merchant.category != UTILITIES OR txn.amount <= 250 THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_utilities_merchant"

prompt: Verified users on rooted devices must be referred to manual review.

rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 100 OR txn.amount >= 80000 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_high_amount"

prompt: Under 7.5 lakh, payments made before 4am are blocked, and so are all payments from devices 60 days old or more.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 750000 AND txn.hour < 4 OR device.age_days >= 60 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_early_hours"

rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [GAMING, FOOD] AND txn.count_1h > 5 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_high_txns"

rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND (txn.amount <= 50000 OR txn.method IN [NETBANKING, CARD]) THEN ALLOW reason="utilities_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: Netbanking or wallet payments by verified users with 2 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours are permitted.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, WALLET] AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 2 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="listed_method_low_failures"

rule: WHEN merchant.category != UTILITIES OR NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="utilities_merchant_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Verified users may pay electronics, travel or food merchants up to 12k inclusive.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, TRAVEL, FOOD] AND user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount <= 12000 THEN ALLOW reason="listed_merchant_kyc_verified"

rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND (txn.method IN [NETBANKING, CARD, WALLET] OR txn.hour >= 18) THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_listed_method"

prompt: Before 11pm, non-grocery payments are prohibited.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GROCERY AND txn.hour < 23 THEN BLOCK reason="grocery_merchant_early_hours"

prompt: Block if the amount is over 500 and the method is not netbanking, and block if the user has no failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 500 AND txn.method != NETBANKING OR user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_netbanking_method"

prompt: Accounts under a month old paying in the hour before 1am, from non-rooted devices older than 5 days, are blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.hour < 1 AND device.age_days > 5 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="new_account_early_hours"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants may not be paid by accounts more than a week old.

prompt: Payments to merchants off the whitelist made before 3pm are blocked.

prompt: Rooted devices are blocked for any user with 20 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours.

prompt: Domestic payments from devices under a week old are declined.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_new_device"

prompt: A payment over 5,000 rupees from a device under 5 days old is blocked when the user has made 12 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 12 AND device.age_days < 5 AND txn.amount > 5000 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_low_device"

prompt: International payments made before 3am are prohibited.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 3 AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_international"

prompt: Accounts two years old or less with more than 5 payments in the last hour and fewer than 8 failed attempts in 24 hours may pass.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 730 AND txn.count_1h > 5 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 8 THEN ALLOW reason="low_account_high_txns"

prompt: Devices a week old or older may make payments.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 7 THEN ALLOW reason="high_device"

rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 4 AND txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING] THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_listed_method"

rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.is_international AND merchant.category == UTILITIES AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 8 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_international"

rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 20 OR NOT txn.is_international OR user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="late_hours_domestic"

rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING, UPI] AND txn.hour < 21 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="domestic_listed_method"

prompt: Refer to review any payment from a verified user on a rooted device, and any payment from a device under a year old.

rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.count_1h <= 100 AND (txn.method == CARD OR NOT user.kyc_verified) THEN REVIEW reason="international_low_txns"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants may be paid from non-rooted devices older than 45 days, when the account is under two years old.

prompt: Non-wallet payments are permitted when the account is 10 days old or more, or the user has fewer than 10 payments in the last hour.

prompt: Domestic utility payments must be referred for manual review.

prompt: Payments to non-whitelisted merchants may pass for users with 2 or more failed attempts in the last 24 hours.

prompt: Devices under a year old may pay up to 2.5 lakh inclusive, when the user has made more than 20 payments in the last hour.

prompt: UPI payments may pass for users with more than 6 failed attempts in 24 hours, on devices older than 120 days.

prompt: Accounts a year old or more are blocked.

prompt: Overnight payments under 10 lakh are blocked for accounts older than 15 days.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 AND txn.amount < 1000000 AND user.account_age_days > 15 THEN BLOCK reason="night_low_amount"

prompt: International payments before 3pm are blocked.

prompt: Payments of 15k or less are blocked.

prompt: Users with 6 or more failed attempts in 24 hours, on devices under 90 days old, go to review when the account is 180 days old or less or they have made more than 25 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 6 AND device.age_days < 90 AND (user.account_age_days <= 180 OR txn.count_1h > 25) THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures_low_device"

prompt: Anything of 1.5 lakh or more from a device under 10 days old must be referred.

prompt: International payments to non-whitelisted merchants from accounts 1 day old or less are blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND user.account_age_days <= 1 AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_low_account"

prompt: Over 12k, payments from devices older than 120 days are referred for review.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 12000 AND device.age_days > 120 THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_high_device"

prompt: Refer to review any payment from a device a year old or less, any payment made from 8am onwards, and any payment where the user has made 25 or more in the last hour.

prompt: Before 1am, payments under 3 lakh are blocked.

prompt: Electronics, grocery and travel payments by non-UPI methods are allowed for accounts two weeks old or more.

prompt: Domestic gaming payments from devices 3 days old or less are allowed.

prompt: Payments are blocked while the user has fewer than 12 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 12 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns"

prompt: Domestic utilities and food payments from accounts 5 days old or less are declined.

rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 180 OR txn.hour >= 13 THEN REVIEW reason="high_account_late_hours"

prompt: A payment may pass if the user has fewer than 20 payments in the last hour or the account is more than 30 days old.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 20 OR user.account_age_days > 30 THEN ALLOW reason="low_txns_high_account"

prompt: Netbanking payments to non-grocery merchants are prohibited.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GROCERY AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN BLOCK reason="grocery_merchant_netbanking_method"

prompt: Block a payment from a rooted device to a merchant not on the whitelist, and block any payment from an account more than 60 days old.

prompt: Users with no failed attempts in 24 hours, or accounts under a month old, must be referred.

prompt: Domestic payments by unverified users who have made 4 or fewer payments in the last hour are blocked.

rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 5 AND (merchant.category IN [GAMING, TRAVEL, ELECTRONICS] OR user.kyc_verified) THEN ALLOW reason="low_txns_listed_merchant"

rule: WHEN txn.amount < 50000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 5 AND device.age_days > 15 AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_high_failures"

rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 25 AND txn.amount <= 1500 AND NOT txn.is_international AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns_low_amount"

prompt: Block a payment if the user has 10 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours and fewer than 20 payments in the last hour, or if the payment is domestic.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 10 AND txn.count_1h < 20 OR NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_low_txns"

prompt: International netbanking payments to whitelisted merchants are blocked for users with more than 20 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 20 AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.is_international AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Electronics, travel and gaming payments must be referred to manual review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, TRAVEL, GAMING] THEN REVIEW reason="listed_merchant"

prompt: Travel payments from 6pm onwards must be referred.

prompt: Users with 4 or fewer payments in the last hour on accounts under a month old are blocked.

rule: WHEN (merchant.category != FOOD OR txn.count_1h < 4) AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 THEN ALLOW reason="food_merchant_low_txns"

rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days <= 60 OR txn.count_1h > 15 THEN REVIEW reason="kyc_verified_low_account"

prompt: Unverified users paying food merchants before 6am from devices under two weeks old are blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 14 AND merchant.category == FOOD AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_food_merchant"

prompt: Rooted devices are blocked for users with no failed attempts in the last 24 hours.

prompt: Devices 45 days old or less have their payments referred for review.

prompt: Users who have made 8 or more payments in the last hour are blocked.

prompt: Devices a year old or more are blocked, as are netbanking payments.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 365 OR txn.method == NETBANKING THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_netbanking_method"

prompt: Wallet, UPI or card payments from devices under a week old are blocked when the user has 5 or fewer payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 5 AND txn.method IN [WALLET, UPI, CARD] AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_listed_method"

prompt: Block payments from devices a month old or more, grocery payments, and payments made from 8am onwards.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 30 OR merchant.category == GROCERY OR txn.hour >= 8 THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_grocery_merchant"

prompt: Non-rooted devices are blocked when paying before 6pm or paying by UPI or card.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND (txn.hour < 18 OR txn.method IN [UPI, CARD]) THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_early_hours"

prompt: Payments before 6am from users with 3 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours go to review.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 3 AND txn.hour < 6 THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_night"

prompt: Block payments made before 9pm, and any payment from a user with 2 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 21 OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 2 THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_high_failures"

prompt: Utilities and food payments are blocked when the user has 3 or fewer payments in the last hour or 6 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, FOOD] AND (txn.count_1h <= 3 OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 6) THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_low_txns"

prompt: Block payments of 40k or less, and payments from rooted devices, where the device is more than 1 day old and the user has 6 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN (txn.amount <= 40000 OR device.is_rooted) AND device.age_days > 1 AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 6 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_rooted_device"

prompt: Domestic payments from users with no failed attempts in 24 hours are blocked.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 1 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_domestic"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant payments from accounts two weeks old or less are blocked when the user has made more than 15 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 15 AND user.account_age_days <= 14 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_low_account"

prompt: Payments to merchants not on the whitelist go to review when the device is not rooted or the payment is international.
rule: WHEN (NOT device.is_rooted OR txn.is_international) AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_international"

prompt: Block any payment of 80k or less, and any payment where the user has fewer than 3 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 80000 OR txn.count_1h < 3 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_low_txns"

prompt: Domestic payments go to review when the amount is over 4k or the device is not rooted.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND (txn.amount > 4000 OR NOT device.is_rooted) THEN REVIEW reason="domestic_high_amount"

prompt: UPI payments from devices under two weeks old, made from 5am onwards, must be referred.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 14 AND txn.hour >= 5 AND txn.method == UPI THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_late_hours"

prompt: Payments from 4pm onwards are blocked, and so are payments from accounts under 10 days old.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 16 OR user.account_age_days < 10 THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_low_account"

prompt: Allow a payment that is domestic and goes to a merchant not on the whitelist, or that comes from an unverified customer.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND NOT txn.is_international OR NOT user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="unlisted_merchant_domestic"

prompt: Accounts under a month old are blocked when the user has 15 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours, or the device is not rooted.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND (user.failed_attempts_24h <= 15 OR NOT device.is_rooted) THEN BLOCK reason="new_account_low_failures"

prompt: Unverified accounts older than 15 days may pay when the merchant is not whitelisted, or when the payment is made between 6pm and 10pm.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days > 15 AND (NOT merchant.whitelisted OR txn.hour >= 18 AND txn.hour < 22) THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_high_account"

prompt: Food and grocery payments from 5am onwards may pass.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [FOOD, GROCERY] AND txn.hour >= 5 THEN ALLOW reason="listed_merchant_late_hours"

prompt: Block grocery and food payments, and payments from verified users.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GROCERY, FOOD] OR user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_kyc_verified"

prompt: Grocery payments of 8k or less are blocked when the user has 4 or more failed attempts in 24 hours or the device is rooted.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.amount <= 8000 AND (user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 OR device.is_rooted) THEN BLOCK reason="grocery_merchant_low_amount"

prompt: Before noon, block payments from rooted devices by users with no failed attempts in 24 hours, unless the merchant is utilities.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 1 AND device.is_rooted AND merchant.category != UTILITIES AND txn.hour < 12 THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_rooted_device"

prompt: Payments of 8k or less may pass if they are domestic, or if the device is under a week old.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 8000 AND (NOT txn.is_international OR device.age_days < 7) THEN ALLOW reason="low_amount_domestic"

prompt: Block a user with more than 5 payments in the last hour when the device is rooted or the merchant is not gaming.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 5 AND (device.is_rooted OR merchant.category != GAMING) THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_rooted_device"

prompt: Travel, gaming and electronics payments, and all payments from non-rooted devices, go to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, GAMING, ELECTRONICS] OR NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="listed_merchant_unrooted_device"

prompt: Non-rooted devices paying by any method other than card or wallet are blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND NOT txn.method IN [CARD, WALLET] THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_listed_method"

prompt: International gaming payments, and any payment made before 6am, must be referred.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND merchant.category == GAMING OR txn.hour < 6 THEN REVIEW reason="international_gaming_merchant"

prompt: Verified users are blocked, and so are devices under a week old.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified OR device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_low_device"

prompt: Devices two years old or more are referred for review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 730 THEN REVIEW reason="high_device"

prompt: International payments to whitelisted merchants may pass.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="international_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Card payments that are international, or that go to food or utilities merchants, must be referred.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND (txn.is_international OR merchant.category IN [FOOD, UTILITIES]) THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_international"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant payments are referred when the user has 6 or fewer payments in the last hour and 2 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 6 AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 2 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_low_failures"

prompt: Grocery payments by a user with more than 10 payments in the last hour go to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.count_1h > 10 THEN REVIEW reason="grocery_merchant_high_txns"

prompt: Payments of exactly 1 lakh to non-whitelisted merchants from devices 10 days old or more, on accounts older than 45 days, go to review.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount == 100000 AND device.age_days >= 10 AND user.account_age_days > 45 THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_exact_amount"

prompt: Payments go to review if the merchant is whitelisted or the user has more than 8 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted OR user.failed_attempts_24h > 8 THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_high_failures"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant payments from devices 10 days old or less must be referred.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days <= 10 THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_low_device"

prompt: Users with no failed attempts in 24 hours and at most 1 payment in the last hour are blocked.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 AND txn.count_1h < 2 THEN BLOCK reason="no_failures_low_txns"

prompt: Refer to review any payment to a whitelisted merchant, and any netbanking, UPI or wallet payment by a user with 50 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, UPI, WALLET] AND txn.count_1h >= 50 OR merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="listed_method_high_txns"

prompt: Non-UPI payments may pass from unverified accounts under a month old when the merchant is not whitelisted.
rule: WHEN txn.method != UPI AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days < 30 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="upi_method_no_kyc"

prompt: Payments to non-travel merchants must be referred.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != TRAVEL THEN REVIEW reason="travel_merchant"

prompt: Refer to review any payment over 10k, any payment by a user with 20 or more payments in the last hour, and any payment by a user with 20 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 10000 OR txn.count_1h >= 20 OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 20 THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_high_txns"

prompt: Block whitelisted-merchant payments by users with 12 or more payments in the last hour, and block any payment from 1am onwards.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 12 AND merchant.whitelisted OR txn.hour >= 1 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Unverified users on rooted devices may make international payments.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND device.is_rooted AND txn.is_international THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_rooted_device"

prompt: Before 9pm, payments under 1,000 rupees are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 1000 AND txn.hour < 21 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_early_hours"

prompt: Wallet payments are blocked for verified users, and for any user with more than 3 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND (user.kyc_verified OR txn.count_1h > 3) THEN BLOCK reason="wallet_method_kyc_verified"

prompt: Food payments from non-rooted devices, made by accounts under 21 days old, are blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 21 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND merchant.category == FOOD THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_unrooted_device"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants may not be paid from rooted devices by users with more than 15 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 15 AND merchant.whitelisted AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Payments from devices 1 day old or more by users with more than 4 failed attempts in 24 hours must be referred.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 1 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 4 THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_high_failures"

prompt: Food payments may pass when they are domestic, or when the account is under a week old.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND (NOT txn.is_international OR user.account_age_days < 7) THEN ALLOW reason="food_merchant_domestic"

prompt: International payments may pass when the device is not rooted or the user is KYC-verified.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND (NOT device.is_rooted OR user.kyc_verified) THEN ALLOW reason="international_unrooted_device"

prompt: Anything of 60k or more from an account more than 2 days old must be referred.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 2 AND txn.amount >= 60000 THEN REVIEW reason="high_account_high_amount"

prompt: Domestic payments of 7,500 rupees or more from non-rooted devices are blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.amount >= 7500 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_amount"

prompt: Block any account 3 days old or more, and any device 3 days old or more.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 3 OR device.age_days >= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_high_device"

prompt: Devices 120 days old or less are blocked, as are users with more than 20 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 120 OR txn.count_1h > 20 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_high_txns"

prompt: International payments by non-wallet methods may pass from non-rooted devices a week old or older.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND device.age_days >= 7 AND txn.method != WALLET AND txn.is_international THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_high_device"

prompt: Utility payments to merchants not on the whitelist are blocked for accounts older than 90 days when the user has fewer than 5 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 5 AND user.account_age_days > 90 AND merchant.category == UTILITIES AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_high_account"

prompt: UPI and netbanking payments may pass for users with 5 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 5 AND txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING] THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_listed_method"

prompt: Domestic payments made before 3am must be referred.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 3 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours_domestic"

prompt: International card payments may pass.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.method == CARD THEN ALLOW reason="international_card_method"

prompt: Non-rooted devices are blocked for users with 15 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 15 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_unrooted_device"

prompt: Users with no failed attempts in 24 hours who have made more than 100 payments in the last hour may pass.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 AND txn.count_1h > 100 THEN ALLOW reason="no_failures_high_txns"

prompt: Refer to review any payment by a user with 3 or more failed attempts in 24 hours, an account 14 days old or more, or a verified customer.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 OR user.account_age_days >= 14 OR user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures_high_account"

prompt: Anything of 3,000 rupees or less is blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 3000 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount"

prompt: Accounts under a month old are blocked from paying merchants not on the whitelist.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="new_account_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Before 11am, payments by users with fewer than 5 failed attempts in 24 hours go to review.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 5 AND txn.hour < 11 THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_early_hours"

prompt: Domestic wallet payments are blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.method == WALLET THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_wallet_method"

prompt: Rooted devices 30 days old or less may pay merchants outside utilities.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != UTILITIES AND device.age_days <= 30 AND device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="utilities_merchant_low_device"

prompt: Rooted devices used by accounts under a week old must be referred.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND user.account_age_days < 7 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_low_account"

prompt: Unverified accounts 45 days old or more are blocked for payments to merchants not on the whitelist.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days >= 45 THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: Unverified users may pay travel merchants only.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != TRAVEL AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="travel_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: Card payments to whitelisted merchants by accounts under two weeks old are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND merchant.whitelisted AND user.account_age_days < 14 THEN BLOCK reason="card_method_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Card payments to grocery and electronics merchants may pass.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND merchant.category IN [GROCERY, ELECTRONICS] THEN ALLOW reason="card_method_listed_merchant"

prompt: International payments from non-rooted devices are blocked when the user has made more than 25 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h > 25 THEN BLOCK reason="international_unrooted_device"

prompt: Accounts 5 days old or more, with fewer than 12 payments in the last hour, must be referred for payments made between 8pm and 11pm.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 5 AND txn.count_1h < 12 AND txn.hour >= 20 AND txn.hour < 23 THEN REVIEW reason="high_account_low_txns"

prompt: Verified users with 4 or more failed attempts in 24 hours are blocked.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_high_failures"

prompt: Domestic payments from non-rooted devices 3 days old or more are blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND device.age_days >= 3 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_device"

prompt: International payments made before 8am by users with more than 30 payments in the last hour are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.hour < 8 AND txn.count_1h > 30 THEN BLOCK reason="international_early_hours"

prompt: Non-wallet payments to whitelisted merchants may pass when the user has 2 or fewer payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.method != WALLET AND txn.count_1h <= 2 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="wallet_method_low_txns"

prompt: Gaming payments of 12k or less, or any gaming payment from a device under a week old, go to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND (txn.amount <= 12000 OR device.age_days < 7) THEN REVIEW reason="gaming_merchant_low_amount"

prompt: Card payments by users with more than 20 failed attempts in 24 hours must be referred.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 20 THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_high_failures"

prompt: Wallet payments of 25k or more are blocked when they are international or made from a rooted handset.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND txn.amount >= 25000 AND (txn.is_international OR device.is_rooted) THEN BLOCK reason="wallet_method_high_amount"

prompt: Payments over 80k are blocked for users with 8 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 8 AND txn.amount > 80000 THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_high_amount"

prompt: Card, netbanking and wallet payments may pass while the user has fewer than 25 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 25 AND txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING, WALLET] THEN ALLOW reason="low_txns_listed_method"

prompt: Block any payment from a device older than 90 days, any payment from 7am onwards, and any payment from a user with fewer than 2 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 90 OR txn.hour >= 7 OR user.failed_attempts_24h < 2 THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_late_hours"

prompt: Rooted devices paying a merchant not on the whitelist, or by users with more than 6 failed attempts in 24 hours, go to review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND (NOT merchant.whitelisted OR user.failed_attempts_24h > 6) THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Anything of 20 lakh or more must be referred.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 2000000 THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount"

prompt: Non-rooted devices are blocked for payments made between 9am and 5pm.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 9 AND txn.hour < 17 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="window_hours_unrooted_device"

prompt: Verified users with 8 or fewer payments in the last hour are blocked.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h <= 8 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_low_txns"

prompt: Block domestic payments, and any payment going to whitelisted merchants.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international OR merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants outside electronics and utilities go to review when the user has more than 8 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 8 AND NOT merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, UTILITIES] AND merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_listed_merchant"

prompt: Payments may pass when the user has 12 or fewer payments in the last hour and the payment is international or the user has 2 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN (txn.is_international OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 2) AND txn.count_1h <= 12 THEN ALLOW reason="international_high_failures"

prompt: Netbanking, wallet or card payments from devices older than 90 days are blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 90 AND txn.method IN [NETBANKING, WALLET, CARD] THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_listed_method"

prompt: Under 5 lakh, payments go to review when the user has made more than 25 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 500000 AND txn.count_1h > 25 THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_high_txns"

prompt: Payments may pass from accounts 21 days old or less, or when made by wallet or netbanking.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 21 OR txn.method IN [WALLET, NETBANKING] THEN ALLOW reason="low_account_listed_method"

prompt: Verified users may pay more than 200 rupees.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 200 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="high_amount_kyc_verified"

prompt: Block payments made before 6am, and payments from non-rooted devices.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 OR NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="night_unrooted_device"

prompt: Refer to review any payment of 2 lakh or more, any payment from 4pm onwards, and any payment from a device 180 days old or more.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 200000 OR txn.hour >= 16 OR device.age_days >= 180 THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_late_hours"

prompt: Domestic payments by verified users go to review when the amount is 15k or less or the device is 7 days old or less.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND user.kyc_verified AND (txn.amount <= 15000 OR device.age_days <= 7) THEN REVIEW reason="domestic_kyc_verified"

prompt: Unverified accounts under a year old with 4 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours, on devices 45 days old or more, are blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 365 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 AND device.age_days >= 45 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_no_kyc"

prompt: Rooted devices six months old or more used by accounts under a month old may pay non-grocery merchants.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GROCERY AND device.is_rooted AND device.age_days >= 180 AND user.account_age_days < 30 THEN ALLOW reason="grocery_merchant_rooted_device"

prompt: International non-wallet payments above 40k are blocked when the user has 10 or fewer payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 10 AND txn.is_international AND txn.method != WALLET AND txn.amount > 40000 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_international"

prompt: Verified users on rooted devices are blocked from paying by netbanking.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND device.is_rooted AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_rooted_device"

prompt: Whitelisted travel merchants may not be paid from 8pm onwards.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.hour >= 20 THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_travel_merchant"

prompt: Domestic travel, utilities or electronics payments from devices more than two years old are blocked for users with more than 5 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 730 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 5 AND merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, UTILITIES, ELECTRONICS] AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_high_failures"

prompt: Block a payment unless both the merchant is whitelisted and the user is KYC-verified.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted OR NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: Block a payment if the user has 10 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours, the device is not rooted, or the user is not KYC-verified.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 10 OR NOT device.is_rooted OR NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_unrooted_device"

prompt: Wallet payments from non-rooted devices under a week old may pass.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.method == WALLET THEN ALLOW reason="new_device_unrooted_device"

prompt: Payments to merchants not on the whitelist made before 1pm go to review.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour < 13 THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_early_hours"

prompt: Accounts under a month old may pay when they have more than 5 failed attempts in 24 hours or 6 or fewer payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND (user.failed_attempts_24h > 5 OR txn.count_1h <= 6) THEN ALLOW reason="new_account_high_failures"

prompt: Devices under 2 days old on accounts under 10 days old may pay.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 2 AND user.account_age_days < 10 THEN ALLOW reason="low_device_low_account"

prompt: Card payments and payments by verified users are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD OR user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="card_method_kyc_verified"

prompt: Domestic payments from accounts older than two years are blocked from 5pm onwards.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days > 730 AND txn.hour >= 17 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_high_account"

prompt: Users with more than 50 payments in the last hour may pay.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 50 THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns"

prompt: Travel payments before noon from rooted devices, by users with more than 8 payments in the last hour, must be referred.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 12 AND txn.count_1h > 8 AND device.is_rooted AND merchant.category == TRAVEL THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours_high_txns"

prompt: Netbanking payments may pass for any merchant other than utilities or travel.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, TRAVEL] AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN ALLOW reason="listed_merchant_netbanking_method"

prompt: Rooted devices may not pay grocery or electronics merchants.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND merchant.category IN [GROCERY, ELECTRONICS] THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_listed_merchant"

prompt: Users with 4 or fewer payments in the last hour go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 4 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant payments from 10pm onwards are blocked, unless the method is wallet or UPI and the merchant is travel.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour >= 22 AND (NOT txn.method IN [WALLET, UPI] OR merchant.category != TRAVEL) THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_late_hours"

prompt: A payment of 10k or more may pass.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 10000 THEN ALLOW reason="high_amount"

prompt: Users with 6 or more failed attempts in 24 hours on rooted devices are blocked for non-travel merchants not on the whitelist.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 6 AND device.is_rooted AND merchant.category != TRAVEL AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_rooted_device"

prompt: From 11pm onwards, payments from non-rooted devices may pass when the merchant is whitelisted or is outside food and travel.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 23 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND (merchant.whitelisted OR NOT merchant.category IN [FOOD, TRAVEL]) THEN ALLOW reason="late_hours_unrooted_device"

prompt: Domestic payments above 3 lakh are blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 300000 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_high_amount"

prompt: Domestic electronics, grocery and travel payments from non-rooted devices are blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, GROCERY, TRAVEL] AND NOT device.is_rooted AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_unrooted_device"

prompt: International payments from non-rooted devices are blocked when the device is two years old or more, or the merchant is not travel.
rule: WHEN (device.age_days >= 730 OR merchant.category != TRAVEL) AND NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_travel_merchant"

prompt: Gaming, electronics and utilities payments are blocked, as are payments by users with fewer than 3 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GAMING, ELECTRONICS, UTILITIES] OR user.failed_attempts_24h < 3 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_low_failures"

prompt: Payments may pass for users with more than 5 failed attempts in 24 hours, or when paid by card.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 5 OR txn.method == CARD THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_card_method"

prompt: Block payments made from 3pm onwards, and payments to whitelisted merchants.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 15 OR merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: UPI payments may pass when the amount is under 2.5 lakh or the merchant is not whitelisted.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND (txn.amount < 250000 OR NOT merchant.whitelisted) THEN ALLOW reason="upi_method_low_amount"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant payments above 2.5 lakh go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 250000 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Rooted devices are blocked from paying before 6am.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_night"

prompt: International payments under 35k from non-rooted devices may pass.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.amount < 35000 AND txn.is_international THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_low_amount"

prompt: travel or gaming txns, domestic only. if the user has more than 20 failed attempts in the last 24h and the amt is up to 25k, send to review
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, GAMING] AND NOT txn.is_international AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 20 AND txn.amount <= 25000 THEN REVIEW reason="listed_merchant_domestic"

prompt: card or netbanking, account 15 days old or less, from 7pm onwards, and fewer than 10 failed attempts in 24h. review those
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING] AND user.account_age_days <= 15 AND txn.hour >= 19 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 10 THEN REVIEW reason="listed_method_low_account"

prompt: whitelisted merchant and device first seen under 45 days ago, allow it
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days < 45 THEN ALLOW reason="whitelisted_merchant_low_device"

prompt: send to review anything where the device is under 120 days old and either the merchant isn't whitelisted or the phone isn't rooted
rule: WHEN (NOT merchant.whitelisted OR NOT device.is_rooted) AND device.age_days < 120 THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_unrooted_device"

prompt: unrooted phones, txns from 1pm onwards: allow
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.hour >= 13 THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_late_hours"

prompt: allow if the account is less than 1 day old, or the amount is 40k or more
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 1 OR txn.amount >= 40000 THEN ALLOW reason="low_account_high_amount"

prompt: kill it if the device is under two weeks old and the user has 30 or fewer payments in the last hour
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 14 AND txn.count_1h <= 30 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_low_txns"

prompt: block non-whitelisted merchants that aren't utilities, when the payment is either netbanking or between 9am and 5pm
rule: WHEN (txn.hour >= 9 AND txn.hour < 17 OR txn.method == NETBANKING) AND merchant.category != UTILITIES AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="window_hours_netbanking_method"

prompt: netbanking from unverified users going to non-whitelisted merchants: allow
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: block if the account is under 120 days old, or the device was first seen more than a day ago
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 120 OR device.age_days > 1 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_high_device"

prompt: food, utilities or grocery, domestic only, 8 or more failed attempts in 24h, device under a week old -> block
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 8 AND device.age_days < 7 AND merchant.category IN [FOOD, UTILITIES, GROCERY] AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_new_device"

prompt: utilities payments from accounts a year old or older, block
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND user.account_age_days >= 365 THEN BLOCK reason="utilities_merchant_high_account"

prompt: domestic txn on a device older than two weeks, send to review
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND device.age_days > 14 THEN REVIEW reason="domestic_high_device"

prompt: anything under 10 lakh at a merchant that isn't food, block it
rule: WHEN merchant.category != FOOD AND txn.amount < 1000000 THEN BLOCK reason="food_merchant_low_amount"

prompt: international payments from accounts under a month old -> review
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days < 30 THEN REVIEW reason="international_new_account"

prompt: cross-border payments under 1 lakh must be blocked
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount < 100000 THEN BLOCK reason="international_low_amount"

prompt: review if phone isn't rooted, or the device is six months old or younger
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted OR device.age_days <= 180 THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_low_device"

prompt: block the non-UPI, non-card txns when the user has 5 or fewer payments in the last hour and amt is 10k or less
rule: WHEN NOT txn.method IN [UPI, CARD] AND txn.count_1h <= 5 AND txn.amount <= 10000 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_low_txns"

prompt: allow everything from users with 20 or fewer failed attempts in the last 24 hours
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 20 THEN ALLOW reason="low_failures"

prompt: netbanking and card txns always go to review
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, CARD] THEN REVIEW reason="listed_method"

prompt: unverified user on UPI or netbanking, 8pm to 11pm, 50+ txns in last hour -> allow
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour >= 20 AND txn.hour < 23 AND txn.count_1h >= 50 AND txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING] THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_window_hours"

prompt: domestic utility bill payments get blocked
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND merchant.category == UTILITIES THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_utilities_merchant"

prompt: electronics purchases at merchants that aren't whitelisted: allow
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="electronics_merchant_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: verified users paying utilities before 11am go to review
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour < 11 AND merchant.category == UTILITIES THEN REVIEW reason="kyc_verified_early_hours"

prompt: before noon, up to 2.5 lakh, merchant not whitelisted: let it through
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 12 AND txn.amount <= 250000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="early_hours_low_amount"

prompt: block non-whitelisted merchants between 1am and 5am
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour >= 1 AND txn.hour < 5 THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_window_hours"

prompt: anything between 6pm and 10pm goes to review
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 18 AND txn.hour < 22 THEN REVIEW reason="window_hours"

prompt: unrooted phone, whitelisted merchant, before 9am: allow
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour < 9 THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: wallet payments from unrooted phones to non-whitelisted merchants, where the device is under 2 years old, need review
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.method == WALLET AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days < 730 THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_wallet_method"

prompt: wallet txn on a device under a week old, block
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND txn.method == WALLET THEN BLOCK reason="new_device_wallet_method"

prompt: if the user has 10 or fewer failed attempts in 24h and the device is older than 45 days, review it
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 10 AND device.age_days > 45 THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_high_device"

prompt: card payments of 200 rs or less on an unrooted phone go to review
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND txn.amount <= 200 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_low_amount"

prompt: grocery, electronics or travel after 6pm: block
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GROCERY, ELECTRONICS, TRAVEL] AND txn.hour >= 18 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_late_hours"

prompt: verified user, whitelisted merchant that isn't travel or grocery, account under a week old: allow
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND NOT merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, GROCERY] AND merchant.whitelisted AND user.account_age_days < 7 THEN ALLOW reason="kyc_verified_listed_merchant"

prompt: electronics, and either the phone is rooted or the txn is from 8am onwards -> review
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND (device.is_rooted OR txn.hour >= 8) THEN REVIEW reason="electronics_merchant_rooted_device"

prompt: travel merchant with 10 or fewer txns in the last hour, block
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.count_1h <= 10 THEN BLOCK reason="travel_merchant_low_txns"

prompt: block when device is over 120 days old and there are more than 12 txns in the last hour
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 120 AND txn.count_1h > 12 THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_high_txns"

prompt: block anything between 2am and 6am
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 2 AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="window_hours"

prompt: rooted device, unverified user, method not card or wallet, device under a week old: block
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT txn.method IN [CARD, WALLET] AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_no_kyc"

prompt: review payments of 100 rs or less when the user has fewer than 20 txns in the last hour
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 100 AND txn.count_1h < 20 THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_low_txns"

prompt: unrooted, device 21 days old or less, from 6am onwards: send to review
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND device.age_days <= 21 AND txn.hour >= 6 THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_low_device"

prompt: 50+ txns in the last hour and more than 2 failed attempts in 24h, block
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 50 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 2 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_high_failures"

prompt: unverified users paying a whitelisted merchant with anything other than card or UPI get blocked
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND merchant.whitelisted AND NOT txn.method IN [CARD, UPI] THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: block if rooted, verified, device 3 months old or less, and merchant isn't travel
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND merchant.category != TRAVEL AND user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days <= 90 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_travel_merchant"

prompt: food merchant, not whitelisted, more than 6 failed attempts in 24h: block
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 6 THEN BLOCK reason="food_merchant_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: utilities, whitelisted, verified user, 30 or more txns in the last hour: review
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND txn.count_1h >= 30 AND user.kyc_verified AND merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="utilities_merchant_high_txns"

prompt: verified user doing an international wallet payment, send to review
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.is_international AND txn.method == WALLET THEN REVIEW reason="kyc_verified_international"

prompt: rooted phone and amount 1.5 lakh or more, block
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.amount >= 150000 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_high_amount"

prompt: verified users, cross-border, 8pm to 11pm: review
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.hour >= 20 AND txn.hour < 23 AND user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="international_window_hours"

prompt: block unverified accounts older than 2 years when either they have more than 20 failed attempts in 24h or the payment is domestic
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 730 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND (user.failed_attempts_24h > 20 OR NOT txn.is_international) THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_no_kyc"

prompt: up to 12 txns in last hour, unrooted, account 45 days or older: block
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 12 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND user.account_age_days >= 45 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_unrooted_device"

prompt: rooted phone buying groceries, block
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND merchant.category == GROCERY THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_grocery_merchant"

prompt: verified user, account under a month old, up to 3 txns in last hour, method isn't UPI or netbanking: review
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND NOT txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING] AND txn.count_1h <= 3 AND user.account_age_days < 30 THEN REVIEW reason="kyc_verified_listed_method"

prompt: unrooted but 50 or more txns in the last hour: block
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h >= 50 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_txns"

prompt: under 4 txns in the last hour: review
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 4 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns"

prompt: device a week old or less, 6+ txns in last hour, whitelisted merchant: allow
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 7 AND txn.count_1h >= 6 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="low_device_high_txns"

prompt: review if (before 1pm and user unverified) or merchant is whitelisted
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 13 AND NOT user.kyc_verified OR merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours_no_kyc"

prompt: verified users on an unrooted phone go to review
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="kyc_verified_unrooted_device"

prompt: more than 10 txns in last hour, rooted, more than 2 failed attempts in 24h, grocery or utilities: review
