rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 10 AND device.is_rooted AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 2 AND merchant.category IN [GROCERY, UTILITIES] THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_rooted_device"

prompt: allow if the phone isn't rooted, or if the payment is before 6am
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted OR txn.hour < 6 THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_night"

prompt: block if international, or 20+ failed attempts in 24h, or merchant is utilities, gaming or grocery
rule: WHEN txn.is_international OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 20 OR merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, GAMING, GROCERY] THEN BLOCK reason="international_high_failures"

prompt: netbanking or UPI under 500 rs: review
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, UPI] AND txn.amount < 500 THEN REVIEW reason="listed_method_low_amount"

prompt: device under a week old, from 10pm onwards, account 10 days or older, paying by UPI, wallet or netbanking: allow
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND txn.hour >= 22 AND user.account_age_days >= 10 AND txn.method IN [UPI, WALLET, NETBANKING] THEN ALLOW reason="new_device_late_hours"

prompt: unverified and paying under 10k: block
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount < 10000 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_low_amount"

prompt: review if (whitelisted merchant AND fewer than 20 txns in last hour) OR the payment is domestic
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.count_1h < 20 OR NOT txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_low_txns"

prompt: unverified users whose accounts are 10 days or older get blocked
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days >= 10 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_high_account"

prompt: review if merchant is whitelisted, or merchant is not food, or user is not KYC verified
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted OR merchant.category != FOOD OR NOT user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_food_merchant"

prompt: block when the device is over a year old, or the merchant is food
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 365 OR merchant.category == FOOD THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_food_merchant"

prompt: unrooted and before 11am: block
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.hour < 11 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_early_hours"

prompt: 4+ failed attempts in 24h, device under 5 days old, unrooted, account two weeks or younger: review
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 AND device.age_days < 5 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND user.account_age_days <= 14 THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures_low_device"

prompt: account under 30 days old AND (5 or fewer failed attempts in 24h OR txn from 2am onwards): review
rule: WHEN (user.failed_attempts_24h <= 5 OR txn.hour >= 2) AND user.account_age_days < 30 THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_late_hours"

prompt: UPI and netbanking: allow
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING] THEN ALLOW reason="listed_method"

prompt: utility payments over 250 rs get blocked
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 250 AND merchant.category == UTILITIES THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_utilities_merchant"

prompt: allow when method is UPI, netbanking or card, or account is over 1 day old, or phone is rooted
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING, CARD] OR user.account_age_days > 1 OR device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="listed_method_high_account"

prompt: device 5 days old or less, merchant not travel: block
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 5 AND merchant.category != TRAVEL THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_travel_merchant"

prompt: unverified users buying at grocery, travel or electronics merchants: block
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND merchant.category IN [GROCERY, TRAVEL, ELECTRONICS] THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_listed_merchant"

prompt: domestic card payments get blocked
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="card_method_domestic"

prompt: unverified account older than 6 months, 2.5 lakh or more, international: review
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days > 180 AND txn.amount >= 250000 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_high_account"

prompt: block if (8 or fewer failed attempts in 24h and rooted) or amount over 100 rs
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 8 AND device.is_rooted OR txn.amount > 100 THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_rooted_device"

prompt: review when the device is under 2 years old, or the merchant isn't whitelisted
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 730 OR NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: devices 15 days or older: allow
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 15 THEN ALLOW reason="high_device"

prompt: wallet, card or netbanking, more than 3 failed attempts in 24h, not KYC, unrooted: block
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [WALLET, CARD, NETBANKING] AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 3 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_high_failures"

prompt: unverified user with up to 25 txns in last hour gets blocked
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 25 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_no_kyc"

prompt: travel purchases of 1500 rs or more, up to 100 txns in last hour, unrooted: review
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 1500 AND txn.count_1h <= 100 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND merchant.category == TRAVEL THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_low_txns"

prompt: review if (whitelisted merchant and account under 6 months old) or user is verified
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND user.account_age_days < 180 OR user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_low_account"

prompt: allow when user is verified and before 8pm, and method is netbanking, card or UPI, or they have 6+ failed attempts in 24h
rule: WHEN (txn.method IN [NETBANKING, CARD, UPI] OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 6) AND txn.hour < 20 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="listed_method_high_failures"

prompt: rooted, unverified, travel, before 6am: block
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_no_kyc"

prompt: zero failed attempts in the last 24 hours: block
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 THEN BLOCK reason="no_failures"

prompt: review anything with under 6 txns in the last hour
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 6 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns"

prompt: block if device is under 3 months old and there are no failed attempts in 24h
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 90 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 1 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_low_failures"

prompt: block when amount is 500 rs or less, or merchant is whitelisted
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 500 OR merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: 2500 rs or more gets blocked
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 2500 THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount"

prompt: anything except netbanking: allow
rule: WHEN txn.method != NETBANKING THEN ALLOW reason="netbanking_method"

prompt: block when method isn't card or netbanking, amount is 100+, and either it's international or before 6am
rule: WHEN NOT txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING] AND txn.amount >= 100 AND (txn.is_international OR txn.hour < 6) THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_high_amount"

prompt: 4+ failed attempts in 24h on a rooted phone: block
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_rooted_device"

prompt: allow if domestic, or if the device is under 10 days old
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international OR device.age_days < 10 THEN ALLOW reason="domestic_low_device"

prompt: block if device under a week old, or phone is unrooted
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 OR NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="new_device_unrooted_device"

prompt: unrooted, before 8pm and under 2500 rs: block
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.hour < 20 AND txn.amount < 2500 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_early_hours"

prompt: over 10 txns in the last hour: allow
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 10 THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns"

prompt: block if (whitelisted and up to 20 txns in last hour) or the phone is rooted
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.count_1h <= 20 OR device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_low_txns"

prompt: Kill international payments that are either wallet, or come with 50+ txns in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND (txn.method == WALLET OR txn.count_1h >= 50) THEN BLOCK reason="international_wallet_method"

prompt: pls send to review: user not KYC, domestic, amt 1500 or more, up to 20 txns in the last hour
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT txn.is_international AND txn.amount >= 1500 AND txn.count_1h <= 20 THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_domestic"

prompt: wallet pmt up to 4000 from a non-KYC user, block
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount <= 4000 THEN BLOCK reason="wallet_method_no_kyc"

prompt: domestic txns that are neither gaming nor grocery get blocked
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [GAMING, GROCERY] AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_domestic"

prompt: for verified users: more than 8 failed attempts in 24h, before 6am, whitelisted merchant, goes to review
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 8 AND txn.hour < 6 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="kyc_verified_high_failures"

prompt: non-card payments from users with zero failed attempts in the last 24h need review
rule: WHEN txn.method != CARD AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_no_failures"

prompt: domestic UPI, or a domestic payment of exactly 1500 rs, block
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND (txn.method == UPI OR txn.amount == 1500) THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_upi_method"

prompt: Block if the user has 6 or fewer txns in the last hour, or the merchant isn't whitelisted.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 6 OR NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: rooted phones doing up to 1 lakh with more than 4 txns in the last hour: let it through
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 100000 AND txn.count_1h > 4 AND device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="low_amount_high_txns"

prompt: Gaming or utilities from accounts over 3 months old are blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, GAMING] AND user.account_age_days > 90 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_high_account"

prompt: domestic payments where either the amount is exactly 30k or the user has 15 or fewer txns in the last hour: allow
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND (txn.amount == 30000 OR txn.count_1h <= 15) THEN ALLOW reason="domestic_exact_amount"

prompt: No failed attempts in 24h, or anything from 5am on: block
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 OR txn.hour >= 5 THEN BLOCK reason="no_failures_late_hours"

prompt: Netbanking to a non-whitelisted merchant, if the user has 20 or fewer failed attempts in 24h, gets blocked.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 20 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: whitelisted merchant, device 90+ days old, over 50 txns in the last hour, and under 20 failed attempts in 24h: kill
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 20 AND device.age_days >= 90 AND txn.count_1h > 50 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_high_device"

prompt: Card payments from verified users are fine, allow.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.method == CARD THEN ALLOW reason="kyc_verified_card_method"

prompt: Block if the user is verified, or the device is under a year old, or it's before 6am.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified OR device.age_days < 365 OR txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_low_device"

prompt: UPI payments that stay inside India get blocked
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="upi_method_domestic"

prompt: netbanking to anything other than food merchants: block
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND merchant.category != FOOD THEN BLOCK reason="netbanking_method_food_merchant"

prompt: Anything from 1pm onwards gets blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 13 THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours"

prompt: users with fewer than 25 txns in the last hour: block
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 25 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns"

prompt: Block anything from 1am onwards unless the merchant is gaming or electronics.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [GAMING, ELECTRONICS] AND txn.hour >= 1 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_late_hours"

prompt: Before noon, block if the account is 6 months old or younger.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 12 AND user.account_age_days <= 180 THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_low_account"

prompt: allow if (cross-border and account 10+ days old) or 5+ txns in the last hour
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days >= 10 OR txn.count_1h >= 5 THEN ALLOW reason="international_high_account"

prompt: Domestic, non-food, non-whitelisted payments from users with more than 5 failed attempts in 24h get blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND merchant.category != FOOD AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 5 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_food_merchant"

prompt: Kill anything over 40k before 9am if the user has 3+ failed attempts in 24h.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 40000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 AND txn.hour < 9 THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_high_failures"

prompt: international card txns, review
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.method == CARD THEN REVIEW reason="international_card_method"

prompt: rooted device, 30k or more: block
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 30000 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_rooted_device"

prompt: Unverified users paying up to 2500 rs get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 2500 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_no_kyc"

prompt: unverified users on netbanking or UPI before 8pm, with a device older than two months, go to review
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, UPI] AND device.age_days > 60 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour < 20 THEN REVIEW reason="listed_method_high_device"

prompt: rooted phone, before 6am, under 12k, under 6 failed attempts in 24h: block
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 12000 AND txn.hour < 6 AND device.is_rooted AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_night"

prompt: Review domestic payments under 40k if the user has 30 or fewer txns in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.count_1h <= 30 AND txn.amount < 40000 THEN REVIEW reason="domestic_low_txns"

prompt: whitelisted merchant, before 5am: review
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour < 5 THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_early_hours"

prompt: domestic payment, account under 120 days old, 5+ failed attempts in 24h, and fewer than 100 txns in the last hour: block
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 5 AND txn.count_1h < 100 AND user.account_age_days < 120 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_high_failures"

prompt: whitelisted merchant, more than 5 failed attempts in 24h, 4 or fewer txns in last hour: send to review
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 5 AND txn.count_1h <= 4 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures_low_txns"

prompt: Account 3 days or older and making an international payment: block
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days >= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="international_high_account"

prompt: Rooted phones with netbanking from accounts a month or older need review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND user.account_age_days >= 30 AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_high_account"

prompt: verified users on wallet or UPI, device under 45 days old: kill
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 45 AND user.kyc_verified AND txn.method IN [WALLET, UPI] THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_kyc_verified"

prompt: review if account is under a month old, or the txn is before 8am
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 OR txn.hour < 8 THEN REVIEW reason="new_account_early_hours"

prompt: block if the user isn't KYC verified, or if the amount is 250 rs or more at a merchant that is neither electronics nor gaming
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 250 AND NOT merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, GAMING] OR NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_listed_merchant"

prompt: Over 2 lakh with fewer than 2 txns in the last hour: review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 2 AND txn.amount > 200000 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_high_amount"

prompt: block if the account is under a month old AND either the device is 21 days old or less, or the payment is international
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND (device.age_days <= 21 OR txn.is_international) THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_low_device"

prompt: Allow international utility payments from devices under a week old, when the user has fewer than 15 txns in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 15 AND txn.is_international AND merchant.category == UTILITIES AND device.age_days < 7 THEN ALLOW reason="low_txns_international"

prompt: Kill if more than 10 failed attempts in 24h, or the account is under 2 days old.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 10 OR user.account_age_days < 2 THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_low_account"

prompt: UPI with either more than 15 failed attempts in 24h or a merchant that isn't whitelisted: block
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND (user.failed_attempts_24h > 15 OR NOT merchant.whitelisted) THEN BLOCK reason="upi_method_high_failures"

prompt: Domestic payments that aren't gaming, before 11pm, go to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GAMING AND NOT txn.is_international AND txn.hour < 23 THEN REVIEW reason="gaming_merchant_domestic"

prompt: verified user, whitelisted merchant, domestic, before 11am: block
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour < 11 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Device under a week old with over 8 failed attempts in 24h: allow.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 8 THEN ALLOW reason="new_device_high_failures"

prompt: 5 or more failed attempts in 24h, and either over 40k or user not KYC verified: review
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 5 AND (txn.amount > 40000 OR NOT user.kyc_verified) THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures_high_amount"

prompt: domestic txns on devices more than 90 days old need review
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 90 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_domestic"

prompt: Non-whitelisted merchants, account 3 months or older: review.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND user.account_age_days >= 90 THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_high_account"

prompt: international to a non-whitelisted merchant from a device 15 days or older: review
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 15 AND txn.is_international AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_international"

prompt: Card payment at a food or electronics merchant, device under 120 days old, needs review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND device.age_days < 120 AND merchant.category IN [FOOD, ELECTRONICS] THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_low_device"

prompt: block if device is over 10 days old and there are 30 or more txns in the last hour
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 10 AND txn.count_1h >= 30 THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_high_txns"

prompt: Wallet payments from a device 1 day old or less can be allowed.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 1 AND txn.method == WALLET THEN ALLOW reason="low_device_wallet_method"

prompt: allow when the user has under 10 failed attempts in 24h and the payment is either domestic or from a rooted phone
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 10 AND (NOT txn.is_international OR device.is_rooted) THEN ALLOW reason="low_failures_domestic"

prompt: whitelisted merchant, amount over 1500 rs, device a year or older: block
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount > 1500 AND device.age_days >= 365 THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_high_amount"

prompt: Block if the device is 15 days or older, or the amount is exactly 5 lakh.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 15 OR txn.amount == 500000 THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_exact_amount"

prompt: rooted phone with under 10 failed attempts in 24h: review
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 10 AND device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_rooted_device"

prompt: Rooted, before 6am, account under a month old and device under 5 days old: review
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.hour < 6 AND user.account_age_days < 30 AND device.age_days < 5 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_early_hours"

prompt: before 1am, unrooted phone, merchant isn't utilities: allow
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND merchant.category != UTILITIES AND txn.hour < 1 THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_utilities_merchant"

prompt: whitelisted electronics, travel or grocery merchant, domestic: review
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND merchant.whitelisted AND merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, TRAVEL, GROCERY] THEN REVIEW reason="domestic_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: unverified users sending over 60k cross-border need review
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 60000 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="international_high_amount"

prompt: rooted phone paying by wallet from 8am onwards: block
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND txn.hour >= 8 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="wallet_method_late_hours"

prompt: allow rooted-phone payments under 5k
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 5000 AND device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="low_amount_rooted_device"

prompt: Domestic payments before 6pm from devices under a week old are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 18 AND device.age_days < 7 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_new_device"

prompt: allow when the device has been around over a month and the user has under 8 failed attempts in 24h
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 30 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 8 THEN ALLOW reason="high_device_low_failures"

prompt: verified users with devices older than 21 days get blocked
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 21 AND user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_kyc_verified"

prompt: any device under a month old is allowed
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 30 THEN ALLOW reason="low_device"

prompt: whitelisted merchant on a device over 15 days old, and either user is verified or amount is exactly 7500: review
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days > 15 AND (user.kyc_verified OR txn.amount == 7500) THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_high_device"

prompt: more than 12 txns in last hour from 9pm onwards: review
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 12 AND txn.hour >= 21 THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_late_hours"

prompt: UPI, gaming, electronics or travel all go to review
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI OR merchant.category IN [GAMING, ELECTRONICS, TRAVEL] THEN REVIEW reason="upi_method_listed_merchant"

prompt: Unrooted phone, account 2 years or older, not KYC, before 5am: block.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND user.account_age_days >= 730 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour < 5 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_account"

prompt: anything of 75k or more, block
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 75000 THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount"

prompt: accounts under a week old paying under 2.5 lakh get blocked
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 7 AND txn.amount < 250000 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_low_amount"

prompt: domestic payment, 20+ failed attempts in 24h: review
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 20 THEN REVIEW reason="domestic_high_failures"

prompt: Rooted phones, device over 6 months old, merchant not whitelisted: review
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND device.age_days > 180 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_high_device"

prompt: verified users paying exactly 80k: allow
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount == 80000 THEN ALLOW reason="kyc_verified_exact_amount"

prompt: whitelisted merchant with 3+ txns in the last hour: allow
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 3 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Block if user has 4+ failed attempts in 24h, more than 25 txns in the last hour, amount up to 50k, and account 30 days or younger.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 AND txn.count_1h > 25 AND txn.amount <= 50000 AND user.account_age_days <= 30 THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_high_txns"

prompt: review if under 3 failed attempts in 24h and it's before 1pm
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 3 AND txn.hour < 13 THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_early_hours"

prompt: Netbanking grocery payments where the user has up to 30 txns in the last hour get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.count_1h <= 30 THEN BLOCK reason="netbanking_method_grocery_merchant"

prompt: domestic with more than 25 txns in last hour: allow
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.count_1h > 25 THEN ALLOW reason="domestic_high_txns"

prompt: allow whitelisted-merchant payments when the user has made 15 or more txns in the last hour
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.count_1h >= 15 THEN ALLOW reason="whitelisted_merchant_high_txns"

prompt: Unverified user, account under 10 days old, before 5am, non-whitelisted merchant: block
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND user.account_age_days < 10 AND txn.hour < 5 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_low_account"

prompt: verified users at non-food merchants with 2 or fewer txns in the last hour and over 20 failed attempts in 24h: review
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND merchant.category != FOOD AND txn.count_1h <= 2 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 20 THEN REVIEW reason="kyc_verified_food_merchant"

prompt: Anything up to 2.5 lakh goes through.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 250000 THEN ALLOW reason="low_amount"

prompt: card payments from an unrooted phone are blocked
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="card_method_unrooted_device"

prompt: before 6pm, unrooted phone, device 2 weeks old or less: review
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND device.age_days <= 14 AND txn.hour < 18 THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_low_device"

prompt: whitelisted merchant with device older than two months goes to review
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days > 60 THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_high_device"

prompt: travel, gaming or grocery payment under 1 lakh, from a device under a week old, with over 30 txns in the last hour: block
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 100000 AND device.age_days < 7 AND txn.count_1h > 30 AND merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, GAMING, GROCERY] THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_new_device"

prompt: Anything not UPI from a device less than 1 day old gets blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.method != UPI AND device.age_days < 1 THEN BLOCK reason="upi_method_low_device"

prompt: verified users before 6am go to review
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour < 6 THEN REVIEW reason="kyc_verified_night"

prompt: verified users from 1pm onwards: review
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour >= 13 THEN REVIEW reason="kyc_verified_late_hours"

prompt: more than 4 failed attempts in 24h plus either a gaming, utilities or travel merchant or a rooted phone: block
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 4 AND (merchant.category IN [GAMING, UTILITIES, TRAVEL] OR device.is_rooted) THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_listed_merchant"

prompt: account 2+ weeks old, over 10 txns in last hour, before 5am: allow
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 14 AND txn.count_1h > 10 AND txn.hour < 5 THEN ALLOW reason="high_account_high_txns"

prompt: verified user, unrooted, device under 7 days, method not UPI: send to review
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND device.age_days < 7 AND txn.method != UPI AND user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_new_device"

prompt: Anything over 250 rs is blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 250 THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount"

prompt: block if the phone isn't rooted, or the account is over a year old
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted OR user.account_age_days > 365 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_account"

prompt: accounts two months old or younger: allow
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 60 THEN ALLOW reason="low_account"

prompt: before 6am on a device 7 days old or less: block
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 AND device.age_days <= 7 THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_low_device"

prompt: Kill it: international, under 50 txns in last hour, and over 10 failed attempts in 24h.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 50 AND txn.is_international AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 10 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_international"

prompt: domestic payments where the user has under 2 failed attempts in 24h, or it's before noon, go to review
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND (user.failed_attempts_24h < 2 OR txn.hour < 12) THEN REVIEW reason="domestic_low_failures"

prompt: Verified users with accounts 120+ days old and devices two months or younger get blocked on anything up to 7.5 lakh.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 750000 AND user.account_age_days >= 120 AND user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days <= 60 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_high_account"

prompt: 25+ txns in last hour AND 60k or more on the same txn: block
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 25 AND txn.amount >= 60000 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_high_amount"

prompt: Unverified user on a rooted phone paying domestically? Review.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT txn.is_international AND device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_domestic"

prompt: Unverified users paying 2.5 lakh+ at anything other than utilities get blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount >= 250000 AND merchant.category != UTILITIES THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_high_amount"

prompt: After 11pm, non-whitelisted merchants go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 23 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="late_hours_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: netbanking from a 15+ day old device, more than 15 failed attempts in 24h and over 10 txns in last hour: review
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 15 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 15 AND txn.method == NETBANKING AND txn.count_1h > 10 THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_high_failures"

prompt: allow it: account under a month old with 5+ txns in last hour
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.count_1h >= 5 THEN ALLOW reason="new_account_high_txns"

prompt: Anything with under 15 txns in the last hour needs review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 15 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns"

prompt: utilities, or more than 30 txns in last hour, or anything from 9am on: allow
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES OR txn.count_1h > 30 OR txn.hour >= 9 THEN ALLOW reason="utilities_merchant_high_txns"

prompt: Unverified users with fewer than 50 txns in the last hour: block
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 50 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_no_kyc"

prompt: unverified users who have under 8 failed attempts in 24h, allow
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 8 THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_low_failures"

prompt: domestic txns on a device 90 days or older go to review
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 90 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_domestic"

prompt: Verified user, non-whitelisted merchant, device under a week old: block.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant that isn't utilities or gaming, when the account is 120+ days old or the method is UPI: allow
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND NOT merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, GAMING] AND (user.account_age_days >= 120 OR txn.method == UPI) THEN ALLOW reason="whitelisted_merchant_listed_merchant"

prompt: Accounts under 2 weeks old with up to 2 txns in the last hour, under 30k: allow
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 2 AND user.account_age_days < 14 AND txn.amount < 30000 THEN ALLOW reason="low_txns_low_account"

prompt: Gaming or travel at a non-whitelisted merchant, paid via netbanking, wallet or UPI, by accounts 2 months+ old: review
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND user.account_age_days >= 60 AND merchant.category IN [GAMING, TRAVEL] AND txn.method IN [NETBANKING, WALLET, UPI] THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_high_account"

prompt: food, whitelisted, up to 15 txns in last hour, 4000 rs or less: block
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND txn.count_1h <= 15 AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount <= 4000 THEN BLOCK reason="food_merchant_low_txns"

prompt: allow if the device is 15 days or older, or the phone is rooted.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 15 OR device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="high_device_rooted_device"

prompt: Rooted phones with 4+ failed attempts in 24h, going to non-whitelisted merchants for up to 40k: allow
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 AND device.is_rooted AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount <= 40000 THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_rooted_device"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant, not gaming or food, not netbanking, under 3 txns in last hour: allow
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [GAMING, FOOD] AND txn.method != NETBANKING AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.count_1h < 3 THEN ALLOW reason="listed_merchant_netbanking_method"

prompt: Kill if international and verified, and either 4+ failed attempts in 24h or device over a week old.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.kyc_verified AND (user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 OR device.age_days > 7) THEN BLOCK reason="international_kyc_verified"

prompt: netbanking from devices 15+ days old: review
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND device.age_days >= 15 THEN REVIEW reason="netbanking_method_high_device"

prompt: Device two weeks or younger? Review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 14 THEN REVIEW reason="low_device"

prompt: Unverified and under 12k with over 15 txns in last hour: review
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 12000 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h > 15 THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_no_kyc"

prompt: Review anything with up to 12 txns in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 12 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns"

prompt: card payments from users with more than 10 failed attempts in 24h go to review, unless it's travel or utilities
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 10 AND NOT merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, UTILITIES] THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_high_failures"

prompt: Rooted + international, and either 30+ txns in last hour or 4 or fewer failed attempts in 24h: block
rule: WHEN (txn.count_1h >= 30 OR user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4) AND device.is_rooted AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_low_failures"

prompt: card txn, device under 2 weeks old, 15+ txns in last hour -> block
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 14 AND txn.method == CARD AND txn.count_1h >= 15 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_card_method"

prompt: over 1 lakh on a rooted phone, when either more than 5 txns in last hour or user is unverified: block
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 100000 AND device.is_rooted AND (txn.count_1h > 5 OR NOT user.kyc_verified) THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_rooted_device"

prompt: Verified users paying from 3pm onwards: allow.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 15 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="late_hours_kyc_verified"

prompt: Before 11am, under 1 lakh, account 45 days or younger: review
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 100000 AND user.account_age_days <= 45 AND txn.hour < 11 THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_low_account"

prompt: non-whitelisted, up to 30 txns in last hour: review
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 30 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Rooted phones with devices 21 days or older get blocked.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND device.age_days >= 21 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_high_device"

prompt: non-whitelisted merchant, over 15 txns in last hour, and either not wallet or account under a month old: allow
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.count_1h > 15 AND (txn.method != WALLET OR user.account_age_days < 30) THEN ALLOW reason="unlisted_merchant_high_txns"

prompt: Block if the phone isn't rooted and the user has 2+ failed attempts in 24h, or if there are 25+ txns in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 2 OR txn.count_1h >= 25 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_failures"

prompt: no failed attempts in 24h: review
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 THEN REVIEW reason="no_failures"

prompt: verified users on rooted phones with under 10 txns in last hour: review
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h < 10 AND user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_low_txns"

prompt: food on a rooted phone, or anything over 500 rs: review
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND merchant.category == FOOD OR txn.amount > 500 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_food_merchant"

prompt: from 4am onwards: block
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours"

prompt: rooted phone, before 8am, 750 rs or less, 4+ failed attempts in 24h: block
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 AND txn.amount <= 750 AND device.is_rooted AND txn.hour < 8 THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_low_amount"

prompt: unverified accounts older than 2 years: block
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days > 730 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_high_account"

prompt: accounts over a month old with up to 6 txns in the last hour: allow
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 30 AND txn.count_1h <= 6 THEN ALLOW reason="high_account_low_txns"

prompt: review if rooted, or whitelisted, or 25+ txns in last hour
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted OR merchant.whitelisted OR txn.count_1h >= 25 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Accounts two months old or younger: block.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 60 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account"

prompt: device under a week old and amount 4k or less: allow
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 4000 AND device.age_days < 7 THEN ALLOW reason="low_amount_new_device"

prompt: block if international, or not wallet, or under 15 failed attempts in 24h
rule: WHEN txn.is_international OR txn.method != WALLET OR user.failed_attempts_24h < 15 THEN BLOCK reason="international_wallet_method"

prompt: accounts 5 days old or less making international payments: block
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 5 AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_international"

prompt: under 8 txns in last hour: block
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 8 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns"

prompt: Verified user on a rooted phone, domestic, merchant not utilities: block
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND merchant.category != UTILITIES AND NOT txn.is_international AND user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_utilities_merchant"

prompt: account 21 days or younger, from 6pm, cross-border: block
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 21 AND txn.hour >= 18 AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_late_hours"

prompt: device 3 days old or less, whitelisted, unverified: review
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 3 AND merchant.whitelisted AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_whitelisted_merchant"
