prompt: travel merchant or rooted phone: block
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL OR device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="travel_merchant_rooted_device"

prompt: wallet, netbanking or card with either more than 4 txns in last hour or unrooted phone: block
rule: WHEN (txn.count_1h > 4 OR NOT device.is_rooted) AND txn.method IN [WALLET, NETBANKING, CARD] THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_unrooted_device"

prompt: grocery, device over 10 days, up to 4 txns in last hour: review
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 10 AND txn.count_1h <= 4 AND merchant.category == GROCERY THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_low_txns"

prompt: verified user buying groceries, and either device 7+ days or merchant not whitelisted: block
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND merchant.category == GROCERY AND (device.age_days >= 7 OR NOT merchant.whitelisted) THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_grocery_merchant"

prompt: block if not card, or unrooted, or international
rule: WHEN txn.method != CARD OR NOT device.is_rooted OR txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="card_method_unrooted_device"

prompt: rooted, account over 6 months, before 6am: block
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 180 AND device.is_rooted AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_rooted_device"

prompt: rooted phone with 4+ txns in last hour or wallet: review
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND (txn.count_1h >= 4 OR txn.method == WALLET) THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_high_txns"

prompt: verified users paying up to 40k: block
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount <= 40000 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_low_amount"

prompt: verified users, or accounts a week old or younger: allow
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified OR user.account_age_days <= 7 THEN ALLOW reason="kyc_verified_low_account"

prompt: cross-border before 1pm: allow
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.hour < 13 THEN ALLOW reason="international_early_hours"

prompt: international, rooted, over 5 txns in last hour, account over 21 days: block
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h > 5 AND user.account_age_days > 21 THEN BLOCK reason="international_rooted_device"

prompt: whitelisted merchant, device over a day old, netbanking/wallet/card: allow
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 1 AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.method IN [NETBANKING, WALLET, CARD] THEN ALLOW reason="high_device_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: grocery cross-border, or anything before 6am: block
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.is_international OR txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="grocery_merchant_international"

prompt: 15+ failed attempts in 24h and up to 100 txns in last hour: block
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 15 AND txn.count_1h <= 100 THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_low_txns"

prompt: unverified, over 2 lakh: block
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount > 200000 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_high_amount"

prompt: card, rooted, international, device under 15 days: block
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND device.is_rooted AND txn.is_international AND device.age_days < 15 THEN BLOCK reason="card_method_rooted_device"

prompt: domestic payments under 2500 get blocked
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.amount < 2500 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_low_amount"

prompt: gaming or utilities before 6am: block
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GAMING, UTILITIES] AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_night"

prompt: netbanking from 10pm onwards to a non-whitelisted merchant: block
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 22 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: device 120 days or less, before 6pm: allow
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 120 AND txn.hour < 18 THEN ALLOW reason="low_device_early_hours"

prompt: device 5 days or less, from 2am, up to 5 lakh, food/gaming/travel: review
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 5 AND txn.hour >= 2 AND txn.amount <= 500000 AND merchant.category IN [FOOD, GAMING, TRAVEL] THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_late_hours"

prompt: unrooted with up to 20 txns in last hour: block
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h <= 20 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_low_txns"

prompt: netbanking at whitelisted merchant with over 30 txns in last hour: block
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 30 AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: block if account over 10 days, or verified, or method not wallet or UPI
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 10 OR user.kyc_verified OR NOT txn.method IN [WALLET, UPI] THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_kyc_verified"

prompt: card or wallet cross-border, or device 2 weeks or older: block
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [CARD, WALLET] AND txn.is_international OR device.age_days >= 14 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_international"

prompt: device over 3 months: review
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 90 THEN REVIEW reason="high_device"

prompt: device under 120 days, over 4 txns in last hour, under 10 failed attempts in 24h, from 5am: block
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 120 AND txn.count_1h > 4 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 10 AND txn.hour >= 5 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_high_txns"

prompt: cross-border, account under 15 days: block
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days < 15 THEN BLOCK reason="international_low_account"

prompt: device over 15 days, 3000+, more than 3 failed attempts in 24h: review
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 15 AND txn.amount >= 3000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 3 THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_high_amount"

prompt: non-grocery, and either up to 8000 or not wallet: block
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GROCERY AND (txn.amount <= 8000 OR txn.method != WALLET) THEN BLOCK reason="grocery_merchant_low_amount"

prompt: block if unrooted, or account 45 days+, or up to 1 failed attempt in 24h
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted OR user.account_age_days >= 45 OR user.failed_attempts_24h <= 1 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_account"

prompt: device 120 days or less, over 7.5 lakh, 3+ failed attempts in 24h, not netbanking: review
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 120 AND txn.amount > 750000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 AND txn.method != NETBANKING THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_high_amount"

prompt: rooted, gaming, non-whitelisted: review
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND merchant.category == GAMING AND device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_gaming_merchant"

prompt: unrooted phone, merchant not food or utilities: review
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [FOOD, UTILITIES] AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="listed_merchant_unrooted_device"

prompt: up to 1 failed attempt in 24h: block
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 1 THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures"

prompt: before 6am, zero failed attempts: block
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 THEN BLOCK reason="night_no_failures"

prompt: account 5+ days, 10+ failed attempts in 24h, before 6pm: allow
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 5 AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 10 AND txn.hour < 18 THEN ALLOW reason="high_account_high_failures"

prompt: UPI from 4pm onwards: block
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 16 AND txn.method == UPI THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_upi_method"

prompt: over 50 lakh, over 20 txns in last hour, device 2 months or less: allow
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 5000000 AND txn.count_1h > 20 AND device.age_days <= 60 THEN ALLOW reason="high_amount_high_txns"

prompt: block if card, UPI or netbanking, or account under a year, or device 7+ days
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [CARD, UPI, NETBANKING] OR user.account_age_days < 365 OR device.age_days >= 7 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_low_account"

prompt: whitelisted gaming, under 3 txns in last hour, not wallet or UPI: review
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 3 AND merchant.category == GAMING AND NOT txn.method IN [WALLET, UPI] AND merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_gaming_merchant"

prompt: device up to 2 years, and either non-whitelisted or rooted: block
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 730 AND (NOT merchant.whitelisted OR device.is_rooted) THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: before 5am, or under 12 txns in last hour: block
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 5 OR txn.count_1h < 12 THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_low_txns"

prompt: up to 10 txns in last hour and either under 15 failed attempts in 24h or unverified: review
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 10 AND (user.failed_attempts_24h < 15 OR NOT user.kyc_verified) THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_low_failures"

prompt: netbanking on unrooted phone: review
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_netbanking_method"

prompt: cross-border, not UPI or wallet, over 8 failed attempts in 24h, up to 30 txns in last hour: review
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND NOT txn.method IN [UPI, WALLET] AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 8 AND txn.count_1h <= 30 THEN REVIEW reason="international_listed_method"

prompt: review if (non-gaming and not wallet) or user is verified
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GAMING AND txn.method != WALLET OR user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="gaming_merchant_wallet_method"

prompt: unrooted, over 10 failed attempts in 24h, before noon: block
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 10 AND txn.hour < 12 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_failures"

prompt: unverified rooted user, up to 25 txns in last hour, up to 50k: review
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h <= 25 AND txn.amount <= 50000 THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_rooted_device"

prompt: unrooted, device 6 months or less: allow
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND device.age_days <= 180 THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_low_device"

prompt: account under 6 months, and either not wallet or over 7500: review
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 180 AND (txn.method != WALLET OR txn.amount > 7500) THEN REVIEW reason="low_account_wallet_method"

prompt: rooted, whitelisted, verified, account under 2 months: review
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND merchant.whitelisted AND user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days < 60 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: travel, up to 10 failed attempts in 24h: review
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 10 AND merchant.category == TRAVEL THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_travel_merchant"

prompt: domestic, account over 6 months: block
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 180 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_domestic"

prompt: device 21 days or older: block
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 21 THEN BLOCK reason="high_device"

prompt: unverified, non-whitelisted, up to 4 failed attempts in 24h, 5 lakh+: block
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 AND txn.amount >= 500000 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: verified, 6+ failed attempts in 24h, over 4 txns in last hour: allow
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 6 AND user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h > 4 THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_kyc_verified"

prompt: exactly 99999 or device over 2 months: block
rule: WHEN txn.amount == 99999 OR device.age_days > 60 THEN BLOCK reason="exact_amount_high_device"

prompt: before 11pm, account 2+ years, over 10 failed attempts in 24h, under 20 lakh: review
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 23 AND user.account_age_days >= 730 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 10 AND txn.amount < 2000000 THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours_high_account"

prompt: rooted, over 4000, under 15 failed attempts in 24h, between 6pm and 10pm: block
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.amount > 4000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 15 AND txn.hour >= 18 AND txn.hour < 22 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_high_amount"

prompt: block if unrooted or under 8 failed attempts in 24h
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted OR user.failed_attempts_24h < 8 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_low_failures"

prompt: over 750, under 3 failed attempts in 24h, up to 25 txns in last hour, non-whitelisted: allow
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 750 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 3 AND txn.count_1h <= 25 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="high_amount_low_failures"

prompt: whitelisted merchant with card, or under 500 rs: block
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND (txn.method == CARD OR txn.amount < 500) THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_card_method"

prompt: account under 21 days, under 8 txns in last hour: block
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 21 AND txn.count_1h < 8 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_low_txns"

prompt: unrooted, 10+ failed attempts in 24h: review
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 10 THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_high_failures"

prompt: domestic, or UPI or netbanking: block
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international OR txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING] THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_listed_method"

prompt: 2+ txns in last hour and account 45+ days: block
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 2 AND user.account_age_days >= 45 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_high_account"

prompt: before 9am: review
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 9 THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours"

prompt: non-whitelisted, account 120 days or less, 60k+, not travel or electronics: review
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 120 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount >= 60000 AND NOT merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, ELECTRONICS] THEN REVIEW reason="low_account_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: unverified, unrooted, food: review
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT device.is_rooted AND merchant.category == FOOD THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_unrooted_device"

prompt: rooted and not UPI: block
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.method != UPI THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_upi_method"

prompt: verified, whitelisted, over 3 failed attempts in 24h: block
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 3 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_high_failures"

prompt: review if (50+ txns in last hour and whitelisted) or account under 2 years
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 50 AND merchant.whitelisted OR user.account_age_days < 730 THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: under 1 lakh, or from 10am, or domestic: review
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 100000 OR txn.hour >= 10 OR NOT txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_late_hours"

prompt: whitelisted, 30+ txns in last hour: allow
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 30 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: non-grocery: review
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GROCERY THEN REVIEW reason="grocery_merchant"

prompt: 50+ txns in last hour: block
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 50 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns"

prompt: cross-border netbanking or UPI under 15k: block
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 15000 AND txn.is_international AND txn.method IN [NETBANKING, UPI] THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_international"

prompt: wallet, rooted, device over 21 days: block
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND device.is_rooted AND device.age_days > 21 THEN BLOCK reason="wallet_method_rooted_device"

prompt: up to 20 failed attempts in 24h or whitelisted: allow
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 20 OR merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="low_failures_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: review if after 11pm, or unrooted, or not netbanking
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 23 OR NOT device.is_rooted OR txn.method != NETBANKING THEN REVIEW reason="late_hours_unrooted_device"

prompt: up to 3 lakh: review
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 300000 THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount"

prompt: device 7+ days and verified: review
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 7 AND user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_kyc_verified"

prompt: whitelisted and (account over 5 days or up to 5 failed attempts in 24h): block
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND (user.account_age_days > 5 OR user.failed_attempts_24h <= 5) THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_high_account"

prompt: unverified, non-whitelisted, domestic wallet: review
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND NOT txn.is_international AND txn.method == WALLET THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: not card, unrooted, domestic, up to 6 failed attempts in 24h: review
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 6 AND txn.method != CARD AND NOT device.is_rooted AND NOT txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_card_method"

prompt: device 45+ days, 5+ failed attempts in 24h, and either whitelisted or travel/electronics/food: review
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 45 AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 5 AND (merchant.whitelisted OR merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, ELECTRONICS, FOOD]) THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_high_failures"

prompt: non-travel, over 100 txns in last hour: block
rule: WHEN merchant.category != TRAVEL AND txn.count_1h > 100 THEN BLOCK reason="travel_merchant_high_txns"

prompt: international, 4+ failed attempts in 24h, 40k+, non-whitelisted: allow
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 AND txn.amount >= 40000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="international_high_failures"

prompt: account 2 weeks+, non-whitelisted: review
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 14 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="high_account_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: rooted, 6+ txns in last hour: allow
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h >= 6 THEN ALLOW reason="rooted_device_high_txns"

prompt: rooted, unverified, utilities/travel/gaming: block
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, TRAVEL, GAMING] THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_no_kyc"

prompt: block if domestic, or if merchant isn't electronics or utilities
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international OR NOT merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, UTILITIES] THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_listed_merchant"

prompt: under 750, up to 15 failed attempts, under 12 txns in last hour, before noon: block
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 750 AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 15 AND txn.count_1h < 12 AND txn.hour < 12 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_low_failures"

prompt: non-gaming, unrooted, device under 6 months: block
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GAMING AND NOT device.is_rooted AND device.age_days < 180 THEN BLOCK reason="gaming_merchant_unrooted_device"

prompt: block if (up to 4 failed attempts in 24h and device 3 months or less) or 15+ txns in last hour
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 AND device.age_days <= 90 OR txn.count_1h >= 15 THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_low_device"

prompt: under 60k: review
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 60000 THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount"

prompt: block if under 20 failed attempts in 24h or unrooted
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 20 OR NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_unrooted_device"

prompt: travel netbanking from account 15 days or younger: block
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND user.account_age_days <= 15 AND merchant.category == TRAVEL THEN BLOCK reason="netbanking_method_low_account"

prompt: domestic, device under 10 days: block
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND device.age_days < 10 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_low_device"

prompt: account over 120 days or device over 45 days: block
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 120 OR device.age_days > 45 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_high_device"

prompt: unverified, before 7pm, unrooted, up to 4 failed attempts in 24h: block
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour < 19 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_early_hours"

prompt: rooted, under 20 failed attempts in 24h: review
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 20 AND device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_rooted_device"

prompt: over 50 txns in last hour, unverified, device over 6 months: block
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 50 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days > 180 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_no_kyc"

prompt: international UPI from device 1 day old or less: block
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.is_international AND device.age_days <= 1 THEN BLOCK reason="upi_method_international"

prompt: unrooted phone, 250+: block
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.amount >= 250 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_amount"

prompt: up to 10 failed attempts in 24h, device 15+ days, non-whitelisted: block
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 10 AND device.age_days >= 15 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_high_device"

prompt: cross-border under 15k: review
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount < 15000 THEN REVIEW reason="international_low_amount"

prompt: card under 100 rs from 8pm, zero failed attempts in 24h: review
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND txn.amount < 100 AND txn.hour >= 20 AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_low_amount"

prompt: unverified users, or whitelisted merchants: allow
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified OR merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: travel or grocery, unrooted, wallet: allow
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, GROCERY] AND NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.method == WALLET THEN ALLOW reason="listed_merchant_unrooted_device"

prompt: unrooted, gaming/electronics/food, and either 3 lakh+ or under 20 failed attempts in 24h: review
rule: WHEN (txn.amount >= 300000 OR user.failed_attempts_24h < 20) AND merchant.category IN [GAMING, ELECTRONICS, FOOD] AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_low_failures"

prompt: from 10pm, not utilities or electronics, not UPI: block
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 22 AND NOT merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, ELECTRONICS] AND txn.method != UPI THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_listed_merchant"

prompt: domestic, unverified, under 10k: block
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 10000 AND NOT txn.is_international AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_domestic"

prompt: wallet, netbanking or UPI from device 15+ days: review
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [WALLET, NETBANKING, UPI] AND device.age_days >= 15 THEN REVIEW reason="listed_method_high_device"

prompt: cross-border over 2.5 lakh from 2am: review
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 250000 AND txn.hour >= 2 THEN REVIEW reason="international_high_amount"

prompt: UPI payments should go to manual review when the device is at least 45 days old and not rooted, and the account is 120 days old or more.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 45 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.method == UPI AND user.account_age_days >= 120 THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_unrooted_device"

prompt: Rooted phones that have 10 or fewer failed attempts in the last 24 hours and no more than 3 payments in the past hour need a person to look at them.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 10 AND txn.count_1h <= 3 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_low_failures"

prompt: Netbanking and UPI are fine as long as the payment stays domestic, so let those through.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, UPI] AND NOT txn.is_international THEN ALLOW reason="listed_method_domestic"

prompt: Let through any payment from a device that was first seen more than 5 days ago.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 5 THEN ALLOW reason="high_device"

prompt: Put travel bookings made before 1am in front of a reviewer.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 1 AND merchant.category == TRAVEL THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours_travel_merchant"

prompt: Stop gaming purchases paid by UPI or netbanking when the device is rooted and it's a new device (under 7 days old).
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING] AND merchant.category == GAMING AND device.age_days < 7 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_gaming_merchant"

prompt: Any netbanking or UPI payment can go through.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, UPI] THEN ALLOW reason="listed_method"

prompt: If someone has made 15 or more payments in the last hour and the merchant isn't grocery, have a person review it.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 15 AND merchant.category != GROCERY THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_grocery_merchant"

prompt: Unverified users on devices that aren't rooted can't pay 80k or more.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount >= 80000 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_no_kyc"

prompt: Payments to travel merchants from phones that aren't rooted are allowed.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND merchant.category == TRAVEL THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_travel_merchant"

prompt: Anything under 12k gets blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 12000 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount"

prompt: For non-rooted devices, decline any payment made before 8pm.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.hour < 20 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_early_hours"

prompt: Domestic netbanking payments from unverified users with 10 or fewer failed attempts in the last 24 hours are allowed.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.method == NETBANKING AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 10 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="domestic_netbanking_method"

prompt: Reject card payments of 10k or less from unverified users when the device is older than 10 days.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.method == CARD AND txn.amount <= 10000 AND device.age_days > 10 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_card_method"

prompt: Once a user has made 3 or more payments in the last hour, let the payment through.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 3 THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns"

prompt: Payments from devices that are more than a day old are allowed.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 1 THEN ALLOW reason="high_device"

prompt: Send wallet payments to review when they're either before 6am or above 7500 rupees, and the user has made 15 or fewer payments in the past hour.
rule: WHEN (txn.hour < 6 OR txn.amount > 7500) AND txn.method == WALLET AND txn.count_1h <= 15 THEN REVIEW reason="night_high_amount"

prompt: Card payments to trusted merchants from verified users on devices older than 120 days should be blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.method == CARD AND device.age_days > 120 AND user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_card_method"

prompt: Hold any international payment for review, and any wallet payment from a user with 25 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND txn.count_1h >= 25 OR txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="wallet_method_high_txns"

prompt: Block UPI or netbanking payments from verified users with 10 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours, as long as the merchant isn't a grocery store.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 10 AND txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING] AND merchant.category != GROCERY THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_low_failures"

prompt: Rooted devices paying from 5pm onwards need a reviewer.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.hour >= 17 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_late_hours"

prompt: Let a payment through if the user has 4 or more failed attempts in the last 24 hours, or the device isn't rooted, or the payment is international.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 OR NOT device.is_rooted OR txn.is_international THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_unrooted_device"

prompt: Stop a payment if the merchant is neither gaming nor grocery, or the method is card, wallet or UPI, or the device is rooted.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [GAMING, GROCERY] OR txn.method IN [CARD, WALLET, UPI] OR device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_listed_method"

prompt: Non-rooted device payments under 20k to merchants that aren't electronics should go to review.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.amount < 20000 AND merchant.category != ELECTRONICS THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_low_amount"

prompt: Before 6am, anything going to a merchant other than gaming gets stopped.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 AND merchant.category != GAMING THEN BLOCK reason="night_gaming_merchant"

prompt: Stop travel or utilities payments when the device is more than a year old, or when the payment is made before 1am.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, UTILITIES] AND (device.age_days > 365 OR txn.hour < 1) THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_high_device"

prompt: Non-rooted devices can't pay more than 100 rupees.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.amount > 100 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_amount"

prompt: Between 8pm and 11pm, card, wallet or UPI payments from users with more than 4 failed attempts in 24 hours should be rejected.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 20 AND txn.hour < 23 AND txn.method IN [CARD, WALLET, UPI] AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 4 THEN BLOCK reason="window_hours_listed_method"

prompt: International payments from a new device get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="international_new_device"

prompt: Accounts up to three months old can't pay between 9am and 5pm.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 9 AND txn.hour < 17 AND user.account_age_days <= 90 THEN BLOCK reason="window_hours_low_account"

prompt: Reject if the device is non-rooted and older than 2 days, or if the payment is domestic.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND device.age_days > 2 OR NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_device"

prompt: Grocery payments from rooted devices go to manual review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND merchant.category == GROCERY THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_grocery_merchant"

prompt: Anyone with more than 10 failed attempts in the last 24 hours gets blocked, and so does any domestic payment.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 10 OR NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_domestic"

prompt: Send accounts older than six months and users who haven't passed KYC to review.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 180 OR NOT user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="high_account_no_kyc"

prompt: Devices under 10 days old on accounts up to six months old need review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 10 AND user.account_age_days <= 180 THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_low_account"

prompt: Before 5pm, payments to travel, utilities or electronics merchants get blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, UTILITIES, ELECTRONICS] AND txn.hour < 17 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_early_hours"

prompt: Decline a user who has fewer than 10 failed attempts in 24 hours, more than 20 payments in the past hour, and an account up to 90 days old.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 10 AND txn.count_1h > 20 AND user.account_age_days <= 90 THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_high_txns"

prompt: A payment gets blocked if the device is under 30 days old, the amount is 75k or less, or the user has more than 4 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 30 OR txn.amount <= 75000 OR user.failed_attempts_24h > 4 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_low_amount"

prompt: Electronics payments from users with fewer than 4 payments in the last hour and more than 6 failed attempts in 24 hours get blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.count_1h < 4 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 6 THEN BLOCK reason="electronics_merchant_low_txns"

prompt: New accounts with no failed attempts in the last 24 hours, on rooted devices, making international payments should be blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 AND device.is_rooted AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="new_account_no_failures"

prompt: Before 11pm, a payment goes to review when the user has 4 or more failed attempts in 24 hours, or the device is two years old or younger.
rule: WHEN (user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 OR device.age_days <= 730) AND txn.hour < 23 THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures_low_device"

prompt: Domestic non-wallet payments from devices older than 15 days get blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 15 AND txn.method != WALLET AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_wallet_method"

prompt: Review any payment where the device isn't rooted, or the amount is 15k or less, or the method is netbanking or UPI.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted OR txn.amount <= 15000 OR txn.method IN [NETBANKING, UPI] THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_low_amount"

prompt: Block a payment if it's international or the merchant is on the trusted list.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international OR merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="international_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Rooted devices paying a merchant other than a travel one need a person to look at them.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != TRAVEL AND device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="travel_merchant_rooted_device"

prompt: Stop anything over 750 rupees going to a merchant that isn't on the trusted list.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 750 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: A payment of exactly 12000 rupees is allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.amount == 12000 THEN ALLOW reason="exact_amount"

prompt: Devices 45 days old or younger get blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 45 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device"

prompt: Trusted merchants, or any payment made from 3pm onward, go to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted OR txn.hour >= 15 THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_late_hours"

prompt: Payments of 7500 or less by UPI, netbanking or card to merchants not on the trusted list get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING, CARD] AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount <= 7500 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Block users who have either fewer than 5 failed attempts in 24 hours or are KYC verified, if they've made more than 4 payments in the past hour and the device is under 120 days old.
rule: WHEN (user.failed_attempts_24h < 5 OR user.kyc_verified) AND txn.count_1h > 4 AND device.age_days < 120 THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_kyc_verified"

prompt: A 50000 rupee payment to a trusted merchant should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN txn.amount == 50000 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="exact_amount_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Before 8am, allow payments from users who have made 8 or more in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 8 AND txn.count_1h >= 8 THEN ALLOW reason="early_hours_high_txns"

prompt: Allow a verified user's payment when they've made more than 30 payments in the last hour, and either the merchant is trusted or the user has fewer than 4 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN (merchant.whitelisted OR user.failed_attempts_24h < 4) AND txn.count_1h > 30 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="whitelisted_merchant_low_failures"

prompt: Utility payments made before 6am, from users with 30 or fewer payments in the last hour, get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 AND merchant.category == UTILITIES AND txn.count_1h <= 30 THEN BLOCK reason="night_utilities_merchant"

prompt: International payments over 7.5 lakh from devices more than a month old go to review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 30 AND txn.amount > 750000 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_high_amount"

prompt: Stop domestic payments to trusted merchants when the user has 4 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_high_failures"

prompt: Accounts up to 3 days old with fewer than 3 failed attempts in 24 hours can go through.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 3 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 3 THEN ALLOW reason="low_account_low_failures"

prompt: From 12pm onwards, verified users with fewer than 20 failed attempts in 24 hours can pay under 60k.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 12 AND txn.amount < 60000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 20 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="late_hours_low_amount"

prompt: Anything over 35k gets blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 35000 THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount"

prompt: Non-rooted devices on accounts six months old or more get blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND user.account_age_days >= 180 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_account"

prompt: Send to review if it's before 6am, or the user has more than 5 failed attempts in 24 hours, or the method isn't UPI.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 OR user.failed_attempts_24h > 5 OR txn.method != UPI THEN REVIEW reason="night_high_failures"

prompt: International payments to trusted merchants before 2am, from users with more than 50 payments in the last hour, are allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour < 2 AND txn.count_1h > 50 THEN ALLOW reason="international_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Payments of 1000 or more from accounts 15 days old or less should be blocked, as long as the user has 8 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 8 AND user.account_age_days <= 15 AND txn.amount >= 1000 THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_low_account"

prompt: Payments from devices under 3 days old that aren't netbanking or card go to review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 3 AND NOT txn.method IN [NETBANKING, CARD] THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_listed_method"

prompt: Unverified users on devices under 45 days old get blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days < 45 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_low_device"

prompt: A payment gets blocked if it's grocery and before 6am, or if the amount is under 1 lakh.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 AND merchant.category == GROCERY OR txn.amount < 100000 THEN BLOCK reason="night_grocery_merchant"

prompt: Before 5pm, look at payments from accounts at least 2 days old on devices more than 60 days old.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 2 AND device.age_days > 60 AND txn.hour < 17 THEN REVIEW reason="high_account_high_device"

prompt: Payments of 60k or less from users with 6 or fewer payments in the last hour should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 6 AND txn.amount <= 60000 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_low_amount"

prompt: Review any payment where the merchant isn't a utility, or the user has made more than 3 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != UTILITIES OR txn.count_1h > 3 THEN REVIEW reason="utilities_merchant_high_txns"

prompt: Reject a payment made before 9pm, or one from a user with more than 20 failed attempts in the last 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 21 OR user.failed_attempts_24h > 20 THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_high_failures"

prompt: Domestic payments from 4pm onwards get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 16 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_domestic"

prompt: Exactly 7.5 lakh rupees goes to review.
rule: WHEN txn.amount == 750000 THEN REVIEW reason="exact_amount"

prompt: Payments before 8am from verified users with accounts up to 90 days old should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 8 AND user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days <= 90 THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours_kyc_verified"

prompt: Users with fewer than 1 failed attempt in the last 24 hours who pay by something other than card go to review.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 1 AND txn.method != CARD THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_card_method"

prompt: Domestic payments made before 7pm are allowed.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.hour < 19 THEN ALLOW reason="domestic_early_hours"

prompt: Trusted merchant payments get blocked when the user has made 50 or fewer payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 50 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Decline payments of 15k or less from devices a week old or younger, at merchants that aren't electronics.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != ELECTRONICS AND device.age_days <= 7 AND txn.amount <= 15000 THEN BLOCK reason="electronics_merchant_low_device"

prompt: Payments to non-gaming merchants from devices 21 days old or more go to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GAMING AND device.age_days >= 21 THEN REVIEW reason="gaming_merchant_high_device"

prompt: Block a payment if the account is 2 days old or less, or the user has no failed attempts in the last 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 2 OR user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_no_failures"

prompt: Unverified users paying gaming merchants are fine, so let those through.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND merchant.category == GAMING THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_gaming_merchant"

prompt: Payments of 1500 or less get blocked when the user has made fewer than 10 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 10 AND txn.amount <= 1500 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_low_amount"

prompt: Verified users on devices two weeks old or less can go through.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days <= 14 THEN ALLOW reason="kyc_verified_low_device"

prompt: Unverified users on rooted devices whose accounts are 60 days old or more need a reviewer.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND device.is_rooted AND user.account_age_days >= 60 THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_rooted_device"

prompt: Allow a payment if it's by card, or it's international, or the merchant isn't trusted.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD OR txn.is_international OR NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="card_method_international"

prompt: Block if the account is 60 days old or less, or the merchant is neither utilities nor travel.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 60 OR NOT merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, TRAVEL] THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_listed_merchant"

prompt: Netbanking payments of 4000 or less, made before 5am to a non-grocery merchant, go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND txn.hour < 5 AND merchant.category != GROCERY AND txn.amount <= 4000 THEN REVIEW reason="netbanking_method_early_hours"

prompt: Review anything paid before 3pm, and anything from a user who hasn't passed KYC.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 15 OR NOT user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours_no_kyc"

prompt: Payments of 3000 or less from devices older than 120 days get blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 120 AND txn.amount <= 3000 THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_low_amount"

prompt: Stop users with more than 30 payments in the last hour and accounts older than six months, when either the merchant isn't trusted or the method is neither netbanking nor card.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 30 AND user.account_age_days > 180 AND (NOT merchant.whitelisted OR NOT txn.method IN [NETBANKING, CARD]) THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_high_account"

prompt: Let through a payment if the device is new, or if the merchant is a travel one.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 OR merchant.category == TRAVEL THEN ALLOW reason="new_device_travel_merchant"

prompt: Travel merchants that aren't on the trusted list get blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="travel_merchant_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: For merchants not on the trusted list, send to review if they're travel, grocery or gaming, or the method is neither card nor UPI.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND (merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, GROCERY, GAMING] OR NOT txn.method IN [CARD, UPI]) THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_listed_merchant"

prompt: Payments over 2.5 lakh from new accounts with fewer than 20 payments in the last hour get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 20 AND user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.amount > 250000 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_new_account"

prompt: Before 6am, non-rooted devices go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="night_unrooted_device"

prompt: From 9am on, block gaming, electronics or food payments when the user has 20 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours and more than 20 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 9 AND merchant.category IN [GAMING, ELECTRONICS, FOOD] AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 20 AND txn.count_1h > 20 THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_listed_merchant"

prompt: Before 11am, block international payments where the user isn't verified or the merchant is trusted.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.hour < 11 AND (NOT user.kyc_verified OR merchant.whitelisted) THEN BLOCK reason="international_early_hours"

prompt: Domestic card, UPI or wallet payments from devices at least 45 days old get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [CARD, UPI, WALLET] AND device.age_days >= 45 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_high_device"

prompt: Food, gaming or grocery payments get blocked when the user has fewer than 20 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [FOOD, GAMING, GROCERY] AND txn.count_1h < 20 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_low_txns"

prompt: Anyone with 15 or more payments in the last hour is allowed through.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 15 THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns"

prompt: Before 4pm, allow payments from users with fewer than 30 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 16 AND txn.count_1h < 30 THEN ALLOW reason="early_hours_low_txns"

prompt: Trusted-merchant payments get blocked, and so do payments from users with 3 or fewer payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted OR txn.count_1h <= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_low_txns"

prompt: Users with 10 or more failed attempts in the last 24 hours should go to review, as should any merchant that isn't travel.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 10 OR merchant.category != TRAVEL THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures_travel_merchant"

prompt: International payments over 10k from users with more than 6 failed attempts in 24 hours are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 10000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 6 THEN BLOCK reason="international_high_amount"

prompt: Verified users shouldn't be able to pay under 1.5 lakh before 5am.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 150000 AND txn.hour < 5 AND user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_early_hours"

prompt: Unverified users on new devices can't pay food merchants.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="food_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: Reject when the payment is domestic and the device is older than 5 days, or when the user has 4 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND device.age_days > 5 OR user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_high_device"

prompt: Rooted devices making UPI payments without KYC, with 30 or more payments in the last hour, should be blocked.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.method == UPI AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h >= 30 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_upi_method"

prompt: Every UPI payment goes to review, and so does any user with 50 or more payments in an hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 50 OR txn.method == UPI THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_upi_method"

prompt: Send to review anything up to 10 lakh, and anything international.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 1000000 OR txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_international"

prompt: Unverified users with accounts 120 days old or less can't pay 50 lakh or less from 10am onwards.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount <= 5000000 AND txn.hour >= 10 AND user.account_age_days <= 120 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_low_amount"

prompt: Unverified users buying from electronics merchants are allowed.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND merchant.category == ELECTRONICS THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_electronics_merchant"

prompt: Accounts older than a week can't pay more than 100 rupees.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 7 AND txn.amount > 100 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_high_amount"

prompt: Decline users whose accounts are 60 days old or less and who have 4 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 60 AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_high_failures"

prompt: Review a payment if there are more than 20 payments in the past hour, or fewer than 5 failed attempts in 24 hours, or the account is new.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 20 OR user.failed_attempts_24h < 5 OR user.account_age_days < 30 THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_low_failures"

prompt: Block when the user has fewer than 12 payments in the last hour and either the amount is 75k or less or the merchant is a grocery store.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 12 AND (txn.amount <= 75000 OR merchant.category == GROCERY) THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_low_amount"

prompt: International payments from accounts older than 30 days get blocked when the user isn't verified or the amount is 3000 or more.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days > 30 AND (NOT user.kyc_verified OR txn.amount >= 3000) THEN BLOCK reason="international_high_account"

prompt: Block international payments to non-trusted merchants when the user has more than 2 failed attempts in the last 24 hours.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.is_international AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 2 THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_international"

prompt: Unverified users with 8 or more payments in the last hour get blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h >= 8 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_high_txns"

prompt: Domestic payments of 2000 or less from non-rooted devices on new accounts should go to review.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.amount <= 2000 AND user.account_age_days < 30 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_low_amount"

prompt: Stop trusted electronics, food or grocery payments from accounts under 45 days old.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 45 AND merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, FOOD, GROCERY] AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_listed_merchant"

prompt: Allow unverified users paying non-trusted merchants when they have 4 or fewer failed attempts in the last 24 hours, or the merchant is electronics, gaming or food.
rule: WHEN (user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 OR merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, GAMING, FOOD]) AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="low_failures_listed_merchant"

prompt: Reject payments to merchants not on the trusted list when the merchant is outside electronics and gaming, or the user has 10 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND (NOT merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, GAMING] OR user.failed_attempts_24h <= 10) THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_listed_merchant"

prompt: Accounts a year old or more on non-rooted devices are allowed.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND user.account_age_days >= 365 THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_high_account"

prompt: Decline a payment if it's netbanking or wallet, or the merchant is neither gaming nor travel.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, WALLET] OR NOT merchant.category IN [GAMING, TRAVEL] THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_listed_merchant"

prompt: Users with fewer than 12 payments in the last hour go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 12 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns"

prompt: Block domestic payments from users with fewer than 10 failed attempts in 24 hours, when the user is verified or the merchant isn't a utility.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 10 AND NOT txn.is_international AND (user.kyc_verified OR merchant.category != UTILITIES) THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_domestic"

prompt: Domestic UPI payments before 3pm from accounts over a year old go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.hour < 15 AND user.account_age_days > 365 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="upi_method_early_hours"

prompt: Allow payments from users with fewer than 30 payments in the last hour and fewer than 4 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 30 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 4 THEN ALLOW reason="low_txns_low_failures"

prompt: Before 8am, domestic non-wallet payments to merchants that are neither electronics nor food are allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.method != WALLET AND NOT merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, FOOD] AND txn.hour < 8 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN ALLOW reason="wallet_method_listed_merchant"

prompt: From 11am onwards, trusted merchant payments from users with 2 or fewer payments in the last hour go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 2 AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour >= 11 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Wallet, card or UPI payments over 50 lakh are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [WALLET, CARD, UPI] AND txn.amount > 5000000 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_high_amount"

prompt: Unverified users paying trusted merchants from devices under 15 days old are allowed.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days < 15 THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Allow international payments, and allow payments from accounts over 21 days old where the user has made more than 3 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 21 AND txn.count_1h > 3 OR txn.is_international THEN ALLOW reason="high_account_high_txns"

prompt: International payments from users with more than 5 payments in the last hour go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 5 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_international"

prompt: Unverified users with at least 10 failed attempts in 24 hours, from accounts a day old or more, get blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 1 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 10 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_no_kyc"

prompt: Payments over 50 lakh from users with no failed attempts in the last 24 hours go to review.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 AND txn.amount > 5000000 THEN REVIEW reason="no_failures_high_amount"

prompt: Card payments before 3pm go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND txn.hour < 15 THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_early_hours"

prompt: Unverified users can't pay 1500 or less.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount <= 1500 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_low_amount"

prompt: Domestic payments from non-rooted devices under 2 days old, with fewer than 50 payments in the last hour, are allowed.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h < 50 AND device.age_days < 2 THEN ALLOW reason="domestic_unrooted_device"

prompt: Domestic payments that come from verified users, or that are made by wallet, go to review.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND (user.kyc_verified OR txn.method == WALLET) THEN REVIEW reason="domestic_kyc_verified"

prompt: Card, netbanking and UPI payments are all allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING, UPI] THEN ALLOW reason="listed_method"

prompt: Allow a payment if the device is rooted and the merchant is neither food nor travel, or the amount is over 1 lakh.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND NOT merchant.category IN [FOOD, TRAVEL] OR txn.amount > 100000 THEN ALLOW reason="rooted_device_listed_merchant"

prompt: Block payments of 200 or more to non-trusted merchants made at or after 1am, when the user has 50 or fewer payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour >= 1 AND txn.amount >= 200 AND txn.count_1h <= 50 THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_late_hours"

prompt: From 8am on, block non-electronics payments to merchants not on the trusted list when the user has 5 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != ELECTRONICS AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 5 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour >= 8 THEN BLOCK reason="electronics_merchant_high_failures"

prompt: New accounts with 12 or more payments in the last hour get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 12 AND user.account_age_days < 30 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_new_account"

prompt: Card payments from devices 3 days old or younger go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND device.age_days <= 3 THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_low_device"

prompt: Between 1am and 5am, block payments from accounts under 15 days old on devices 120 days old or younger.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 1 AND txn.hour < 5 AND user.account_age_days < 15 AND device.age_days <= 120 THEN BLOCK reason="window_hours_low_account"

prompt: Before 10pm, payments to non-travel merchants made by anything other than UPI or netbanking go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 22 AND merchant.category != TRAVEL AND NOT txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING] THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours_travel_merchant"

prompt: Verified users making international payments go to review when they've made 100 or more payments in the last hour, or the merchant is gaming, grocery or utilities.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.kyc_verified AND (txn.count_1h >= 100 OR merchant.category IN [GAMING, GROCERY, UTILITIES]) THEN REVIEW reason="international_kyc_verified"

prompt: International payments to gaming, food or travel merchants get blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GAMING, FOOD, TRAVEL] AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_international"

prompt: Stop if the payment is domestic, or the user has fewer than 30 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international OR txn.count_1h < 30 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_low_txns"

prompt: Send to review if the amount is 1.5 lakh or less, or the merchant is neither electronics nor grocery.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 150000 OR NOT merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, GROCERY] THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_listed_merchant"

prompt: International UPI payments from accounts 15 days old or more get blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 15 AND txn.method == UPI AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_upi_method"

prompt: Non-rooted devices get blocked if the payment is before 6am, or the device is more than 60 days old.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND (txn.hour < 6 OR device.age_days > 60) THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_night"

prompt: Rooted devices under 15 days old with fewer than 100 payments in the last hour go to review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND device.age_days < 15 AND txn.count_1h < 100 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_low_device"

prompt: Netbanking payments from accounts 21 days old or older go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND user.account_age_days >= 21 THEN REVIEW reason="netbanking_method_high_account"

prompt: Anything that isn't netbanking or UPI goes to review.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.method IN [NETBANKING, UPI] THEN REVIEW reason="listed_method"

prompt: Review is needed if it is from 11pm onwards, or if the device is not rooted.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 23 OR NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="late_hours_unrooted_device"

prompt: Trusted electronics and utilities merchants are allowed through.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, UTILITIES] AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="listed_merchant_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Grocery payments from accounts under 2 days old get blocked when they're netbanking or the user has 6 or fewer payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN (txn.method == NETBANKING OR txn.count_1h <= 6) AND merchant.category == GROCERY AND user.account_age_days < 2 THEN BLOCK reason="netbanking_method_low_txns"

prompt: Unverified users may pay by card, netbanking or wallet.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING, WALLET] AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="listed_method_no_kyc"

prompt: Accounts under 3 days old can't pay by a method other than UPI when buying electronics or paying 10k or more.
rule: WHEN txn.method != UPI AND user.account_age_days < 3 AND (merchant.category == ELECTRONICS OR txn.amount >= 10000) THEN BLOCK reason="upi_method_low_account"

prompt: Unverified users making international payments, with fewer than 4 payments in the last hour, go to review.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h < 4 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_low_txns"

prompt: From 5pm onwards, block payments from devices under 5 days old where the user has 4 or fewer payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 5 AND txn.hour >= 17 AND txn.count_1h <= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_late_hours"

prompt: Gaming or travel payments before 6am get blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GAMING, TRAVEL] AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_night"

prompt: Card payments to trusted utility merchants get blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND txn.method == CARD AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="utilities_merchant_card_method"

prompt: Payments of 1 lakh or less go to review when the user isn't verified or the payment is before 9am.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 100000 AND (NOT user.kyc_verified OR txn.hour < 9) THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_no_kyc"

prompt: Non-rooted devices get blocked when the payment is international or the user isn't verified.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND (txn.is_international OR NOT user.kyc_verified) THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_international"

prompt: Anything going to a trusted merchant or an electronics merchant gets blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted OR merchant.category == ELECTRONICS THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_electronics_merchant"

prompt: Travel payments from users with 8 or more failed attempts in 24 hours get blocked.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 8 AND merchant.category == TRAVEL THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_travel_merchant"

prompt: Unverified users with 100 or fewer payments in the last hour get blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h <= 100 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_low_txns"

prompt: Accounts a week old or more can pay trusted merchants.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 7 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="high_account_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Payments of 2.5 lakh or more get blocked when the device is under a day old or the payment is domestic.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 250000 AND (device.age_days < 1 OR NOT txn.is_international) THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_low_device"

prompt: Trusted merchant payments from devices under 60 days old get blocked when the user isn't verified or the amount is 50k or more.
rule: WHEN (NOT user.kyc_verified OR txn.amount >= 50000) AND device.age_days < 60 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_high_amount"

prompt: Domestic payments from rooted devices under 60 days old, from accounts a week old or younger, are allowed.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 60 AND user.account_age_days <= 7 AND device.is_rooted AND NOT txn.is_international THEN ALLOW reason="low_device_low_account"

prompt: Reject payments from users with fewer than 8 payments in the last hour and 5 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 8 AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 5 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_low_failures"

prompt: Netbanking payments before 6am from non-rooted devices, where the user has fewer than 100 payments in the last hour, go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 100 AND txn.hour < 6 AND txn.method == NETBANKING AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_night"

prompt: Domestic payments before 9pm get blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.hour < 21 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_early_hours"

prompt: Verified users on devices a day old or less get blocked.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days <= 1 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_low_device"

prompt: Utility payments to merchants not on the trusted list go to review.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND merchant.category == UTILITIES THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_utilities_merchant"

prompt: Send to review if the amount is under 200 rupees, or the device isn't rooted.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 200 OR NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_unrooted_device"

prompt: Rooted devices on accounts a year old or younger, paying up to 40k to merchants not on the trusted list, go to review.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 365 AND device.is_rooted AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount <= 40000 THEN REVIEW reason="low_account_rooted_device"

prompt: Devices two years old or younger, from users with 4 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours, go to review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 730 AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_low_failures"

prompt: Allow a payment if the user hasn't passed KYC, or the amount is over 50k.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified OR txn.amount > 50000 THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_high_amount"

prompt: Before 4pm, unverified users making international payments go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 16 AND txn.is_international AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours_international"

prompt: Utility payments of 10k or less to merchants that aren't trusted go to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND txn.amount <= 10000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="utilities_merchant_low_amount"

prompt: Decline when the account is 90 days old or younger but the device is a year old or more.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 90 AND device.age_days >= 365 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_high_device"

prompt: Allow it if it's a wallet payment before 3am, or the user has made more than 25 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND txn.hour < 3 OR txn.count_1h > 25 THEN ALLOW reason="wallet_method_early_hours"

prompt: Block if the user has fewer than 2 payments in the last hour, or the device is new, or the payment is from 5pm onwards.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 2 OR device.age_days < 7 OR txn.hour >= 17 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_new_device"

prompt: Block payments of 7500 or less from devices under two years old, when the user has fewer than 6 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 730 AND txn.amount <= 7500 AND txn.count_1h < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_low_amount"

prompt: Non-rooted devices can't pay gaming, grocery or electronics merchants.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GAMING, GROCERY, ELECTRONICS] AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_unrooted_device"

prompt: Verified users on devices a week old or younger, paying under 2.5 lakh or going to a travel merchant, go to review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 7 AND user.kyc_verified AND (txn.amount < 250000 OR merchant.category == TRAVEL) THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_kyc_verified"

prompt: Allow payments to non-trusted merchants when the user has made 25 or more in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 25 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Electronics or utilities payments are allowed when the user has more than 10 payments in the last hour, the device is six months old or more, and there are 15 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 10 AND device.age_days >= 180 AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 15 AND merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, UTILITIES] THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns_high_device"

prompt: From 6am on, allow payments to non-trusted merchants by users with fewer than 100 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 100 AND txn.hour >= 6 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="low_txns_late_hours"

prompt: Users with more than 6 payments in the last hour, paying electronics merchants or trusted merchants, go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 6 AND (merchant.category == ELECTRONICS OR merchant.whitelisted) THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_electronics_merchant"

prompt: Payments over 12k to merchants not on the trusted list are allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 12000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="high_amount_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Unverified users with 8 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours get blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 8 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_low_failures"

prompt: Stop payments of 2500 or more from users with more than 5 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 5 AND txn.amount >= 2500 THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_high_amount"

prompt: Allow a payment if it's domestic, or the merchant is trusted, or the account is new.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international OR merchant.whitelisted OR user.account_age_days < 30 THEN ALLOW reason="domestic_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Verified users on rooted devices with 8 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours, paying non-trusted merchants, go to review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 8 AND user.kyc_verified AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_low_failures"

prompt: Card payments under 8k go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND txn.amount < 8000 THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_low_amount"

prompt: Trusted merchant payments from non-rooted devices are allowed.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="whitelisted_merchant_unrooted_device"

prompt: Only card and netbanking payments are accepted, so block anything else.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING] THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method"

prompt: New accounts paying under 8000 go to review.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.amount < 8000 THEN REVIEW reason="new_account_low_amount"

prompt: Rooted devices with fewer than 6 failed attempts in the last 24 hours are allowed.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 6 THEN ALLOW reason="rooted_device_low_failures"

prompt: Anyone with 8 or more payments in the last hour, or 15 or more failed attempts in 24 hours, is blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 8 OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 15 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_high_failures"

prompt: Non-wallet payments from accounts 30 days old or younger get blocked when the device isn't rooted or the user has 2 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.method != WALLET AND user.account_age_days <= 30 AND (NOT device.is_rooted OR txn.count_1h >= 2) THEN BLOCK reason="wallet_method_low_account"

prompt: Food merchant payments from accounts older than 3 days get blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND user.account_age_days > 3 THEN BLOCK reason="food_merchant_high_account"

prompt: Anything from a device a week old or younger gets blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 7 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device"

prompt: Verified users with accounts 10 days old or more can't pay trusted merchants.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 10 AND user.kyc_verified AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_kyc_verified"

prompt: Allow payments to merchants not on the trusted list when the method is UPI, wallet or card, or the merchant is electronics, grocery or travel.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND (txn.method IN [UPI, WALLET, CARD] OR merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, GROCERY, TRAVEL]) THEN ALLOW reason="unlisted_merchant_listed_method"

prompt: Users with more than 2 failed attempts in the last 24 hours go to review.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 2 THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures"

prompt: From 6am on, rooted devices paying anyone other than food or gaming merchants go to review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND NOT merchant.category IN [FOOD, GAMING] AND txn.hour >= 6 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_listed_merchant"

prompt: Domestic netbanking payments to non-trusted merchants, from users with fewer than 10 failed attempts in 24 hours, go to review.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 10 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND NOT txn.is_international AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Unverified users with accounts over two years old can't pay by card.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 730 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.method == CARD THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_no_kyc"

prompt: Rooted devices at least 21 days old, with accounts older than a week, paying non-trusted merchants go to review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days >= 21 AND user.account_age_days > 7 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Reject if the merchant is trusted and the user isn't verified, or the account is 15 days old or less.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND NOT user.kyc_verified OR user.account_age_days <= 15 THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: Electronics, food or travel payments by users with fewer than 1 failed attempt in 24 hours, using a method other than UPI or wallet, go to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, FOOD, TRAVEL] AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 1 AND NOT txn.method IN [UPI, WALLET] THEN REVIEW reason="listed_merchant_low_failures"

prompt: Verified users with fewer than 8 payments in the last hour go to review.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h < 8 THEN REVIEW reason="kyc_verified_low_txns"

prompt: Utility payments from devices at least 120 days old, on accounts older than 5 days, are allowed.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND device.age_days >= 120 AND user.account_age_days > 5 THEN ALLOW reason="utilities_merchant_high_device"

prompt: Wallet payments from users with 3 or more failed attempts in 24 hours are allowed.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 AND txn.method == WALLET THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_wallet_method"

prompt: Electronics payments get blocked when the device is rooted or the account is under two years old.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND (device.is_rooted OR user.account_age_days < 730) THEN BLOCK reason="electronics_merchant_rooted_device"

prompt: Decline a payment if the user has more than 10 in the last hour, or the device is 45 days old or more.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 10 OR device.age_days >= 45 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_high_device"

prompt: Wallet payments from rooted devices six months old or more, by users with fewer than 30 payments in the last hour, get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 30 AND txn.method == WALLET AND device.age_days >= 180 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_wallet_method"

prompt: Domestic payments of 30k or more get blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.amount >= 30000 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_high_amount"

prompt: Unverified users paying UPI to grocery or travel merchants, with fewer than 20 payments in the last hour, are allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 20 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.method == UPI AND merchant.category IN [GROCERY, TRAVEL] THEN ALLOW reason="low_txns_no_kyc"

prompt: Wallet payments to non-trusted merchants from non-rooted devices get blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.method == WALLET AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_wallet_method"

prompt: Allow a payment if it's 60k or more, or it's UPI, or the merchant isn't trusted.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 60000 OR txn.method == UPI OR NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="high_amount_upi_method"

prompt: Netbanking from a non-rooted device that's a week old or younger gets blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 7 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_unrooted_device"

prompt: Domestic netbanking or card payments from rooted devices get blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.method IN [NETBANKING, CARD] AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_listed_method"

prompt: Let through any payment made before 2pm, or any payment from a new account.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 14 OR user.account_age_days < 30 THEN ALLOW reason="early_hours_low_account"

prompt: UPI electronics purchases from new devices get blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND txn.method == UPI AND merchant.category == ELECTRONICS THEN BLOCK reason="new_device_upi_method"

prompt: Users with 2 or fewer payments in the last hour, who are either on a non-rooted device or verified, go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 2 AND (NOT device.is_rooted OR user.kyc_verified) THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns_unrooted_device"

prompt: Domestic UPI payments of 25k or more from users with more than 10 failed attempts in 24 hours go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 25000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 10 AND NOT txn.is_international AND txn.method == UPI THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_high_failures"

prompt: Rooted devices making international payments get blocked.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_international"

prompt: Verified users paying non-trusted merchants get blocked when the device is rooted or the payment is before 6am.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND (device.is_rooted OR txn.hour < 6) THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Block devices 10 days old or younger, except food payments from accounts a year old or more.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 10 AND (merchant.category != FOOD OR user.account_age_days < 365) THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_food_merchant"

prompt: Allow wallet payments from devices under two weeks old, where the user has fewer than 10 payments in the last hour and more than 6 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND txn.count_1h < 10 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 6 AND device.age_days < 14 THEN ALLOW reason="wallet_method_low_txns"

prompt: Users with 30 or fewer payments in the last hour go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 30 THEN REVIEW reason="low_txns"

prompt: Block users with 8 or more failed attempts in 24 hours, unless the payment is international and made before 5am.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 8 AND (NOT txn.is_international OR txn.hour >= 5) THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_domestic"

prompt: Rooted devices paying from 3pm onwards go to review.

prompt: Payments of 10 lakh or more before 6am go to review.

prompt: Allow unverified users' payments to merchants other than utilities and electronics, from devices older than a day.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, ELECTRONICS] AND device.age_days > 1 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="listed_merchant_high_device"

prompt: Card payments from accounts over a year old get blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 365 AND txn.method == CARD THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_card_method"

prompt: Stop if the user has 2 or more payments in the last hour on a rooted device, or the amount is 15k or less.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 2 AND device.is_rooted OR txn.amount <= 15000 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_rooted_device"

prompt: Domestic payments up to 1000 from non-rooted devices get blocked.

prompt: Devices 3 days old or older go to review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 3 THEN REVIEW reason="high_device"

prompt: Unverified users paying trusted merchants under 80k, from 2am onwards, get blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount < 80000 AND txn.hour >= 2 THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: Utility payments from users with 3 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours get blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="utilities_merchant_low_failures"

prompt: From 6am on, block non-rooted devices 15 days old or older paying non-trusted merchants.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 15 AND txn.hour >= 6 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_late_hours"

prompt: Reject payments to non-gaming merchants from new devices.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GAMING AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="gaming_merchant_new_device"

prompt: Verified new accounts can't buy from electronics merchants.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="new_account_electronics_merchant"

prompt: Unverified users paying over 5 lakh go to review.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount > 500000 THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_high_amount"

prompt: Decline any payment from a device more than a day old.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 1 THEN BLOCK reason="high_device"

prompt: Unverified users with fewer than 1 failed attempt in 24 hours are allowed.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 1 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="low_failures_no_kyc"

prompt: Non-rooted devices where the user has 4 or more failed attempts in 24 hours and fewer than 2 payments in the last hour go to review.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 AND txn.count_1h < 2 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures_low_txns"

prompt: UPI payments from non-rooted devices are allowed for users with more than 5 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 5 AND txn.method == UPI AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_upi_method"

prompt: Block non-rooted device payments when the user has more than 100 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h > 100 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_txns"

prompt: Travel payments to non-trusted merchants from accounts two years old or younger get blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND user.account_age_days <= 730 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="travel_merchant_low_account"

prompt: Allow payments from devices 21 days old or younger, if the merchant is trusted or the user has fewer than 4 failed attempts in 24 hours.
